<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" ?><rss version='2.0' xmlns:atom='http://www.w3.org/2005/Atom'><channel><atom:link href='https://jobs.tetrapak.com/feeds/(data)/?locale=en_GB' rel='self' type='application/rss+xml' /><title>Tetra Pak - Custom Search (data)</title><link>https://jobs.tetrapak.com/feeds/(data)/?locale=en_GB</link><description>Custom RSS Feed forTetra Pak</description><lastBuildDate>Fri, 23 Oct 2026 19:16:24 GMT</lastBuildDate><language>en-gb</language><image><url></url><title><![CDATA[Tetra Pak - Custom Search (data)]]></title><link>https://jobs.tetrapak.com/feeds/(data)/?locale=en_GB</link></image><ttl>720</ttl> <item><title><![CDATA[System Support Specialist (Gotemba, JP)]]></title><description><![CDATA[<p style="text-align:center"> </p>
<p style="text-align:center"><span style="font-size:12.0pt"><em>At Tetra Pak we commit to making food safe and available, everywhere; and we protect what's good – protecting food, protecting people, and protecting the planet. By doing so we touch millions of people's lives every day. </em></span></p>
<p style="text-align:center"><span style="font-size:12.0pt"><em>And we need people like you to make it happen.</em></span></p>
<p style="text-align:center"><span style="font-size:12.0pt"><strong><em>We empower you to reach your potential with opportunities to  make an impact to be proud of – for food, people and the planet.</em></strong></span></p>
<p style="text-align:center"> </p><div><div style="padding:10.0px 0.0px;border:1.0px solid transparent"><div style="font-size:16.0px;word-wrap:break-word"><H2 style="font-size:1.0em;margin:0.0px"><b>Job Summary</b></H2></div><div><p>Nihon TetraPak is seeking an open-minded and highly motivated professional to strengthen its CIR System Support team. <br>We are looking for a System Support Associate who will provide technical consulting and expert support for Tetra Brik filling machine systems. <br>In this role, you will contribute to building organizational competence, managing transferred technical issues, and driving continuous system and equipment improvements based on performance data.<br>The position can be based in Gotemba or Tokyo, Japan.</p></div></div><div style="padding:10.0px 0.0px;border:1.0px solid transparent"><div style="font-size:16.0px;word-wrap:break-word"><H2 style="font-size:1.0em;margin:0.0px"><b>What you will do</b></H2></div><div><p>As a System Support Associate, you will:<br><br></p>
<ul>
<li>Lead the deployment of next-generation filling machines in Japan and other markets</li>
<li>Apply automation expertise and work as an ARA Expert</li>
<li>Support installation projects with system-specific expertise, focusing on NPI and MC readiness</li>
<li>Audit filling lines and drive performance improvement initiatives</li>
<li>Perform troubleshooting and root cause analysis using established problem-solving methodologies</li>
<li>Build and maintain strong technical networks at both regional and global levels</li>
<li>Provide support and share expertise with TetraPak colleagues and Customer</li>
<li>Support KA teams in business opportunity analysis</li>
<li>Support field testing activities for CS and PS</li>
<li>Identify technical issues and drive containment solutions</li>
<li>Perform Technical Assistance Reporting, including QuTI-P, during all related activities</li>
</ul></div></div><div style="padding:10.0px 0.0px;border:1.0px solid transparent"><div style="font-size:16.0px;word-wrap:break-word"><H2 style="font-size:1.0em;margin:0.0px"><b>We believe you have</b></H2></div><div><ul>
<li>A self-motivated attitude with a high degree of initiative</li>
<li>+3 years of experience in installation, maintenance, and service work on A1/A3/E3 machine systems</li>
<li>A strong customer-focused mindset</li>
<li>Experience combining customer management with technical discussions and negotiations</li>
<li>Good leadership skills</li>
<li>The ability to mentor and coach peers</li>
<li>Willingness to travel domestically within Japan and internationally</li>
<li>Fluency in Japanese, both written and spoken</li>
<li>Working-level technical English proficiency; candidates with a strong motivation to improve their English are welcome</li>
</ul></div></div></div><p><span style="font-size:16.0px"><strong>We Offer You</strong></span></p>
<ul>
<li style="font-size:12.0pt"><span style="font-size:12.0pt">A variety of exciting challenges with ample opportunities for development and training in a truly global landscape</span></li>
<li style="font-size:12.0pt"><span style="font-size:12.0pt">A culture that pioneers a spirit of innovation where our industry experts drive visible results</span></li>
<li style="font-size:12.0pt"><span style="font-size:12.0pt">An equal opportunity employment experience that values diversity and inclusion</span></li>
<li style="font-size:12.0pt"><span style="font-size:12.0pt">Market competitive compensation and benefits with flexible working arrangements</span></li>
</ul>
<p> </p>
<p><span style="font-size:16.0px"><strong>Apply Now</strong></span></p>
<p><span style="font-size:12.0pt">If you are inspired to be part of our promise to protect what’s good; for food, people, and the planet, apply through our careers page at <a href="https://jobs.tetrapak.com/" target="_blank" rel="noopener">https://jobs.tetrapak.com/</a>. </span></p>
<p><span style="font-size:12.0pt">This job posting expires on<strong> <span style="font-size:12.0pt"><span style="font-size:12.0pt">30/11/2026.</span></span></strong></span></p>
<p><span style="font-size:12.0pt">If you have any questions about your application, please contact <strong>Shun Aoki</strong>.</span></p>
<p> </p>
<p><span style="font-size:14.0px"><em>Diversity, equity, and inclusion is an everyday part of how we work. We give people a place to belong and support to thrive, an environment where everyone can be comfortable being themselves and has equal opportunities to grow and succeed. We embrace difference, celebrate people for who they are, and for the diversity they bring that helps us better understand and connect with our customers and communities worldwide.</em></span></p>
<p> </p>]]></description><pubDate>Fri, 23 Oct 2026 2:00:00 GMT</pubDate><link>https://jobs.tetrapak.com/job/Gotemba-System-Support-Specialist/1409271633/?feedId=null&amp;utm_source=J2WRSS&amp;utm_medium=rss&amp;utm_campaign=J2W_RSS</link><guid>https://jobs.tetrapak.com/job/Gotemba-System-Support-Specialist/1409271633/?feedId=null&amp;utm_source=J2WRSS&amp;utm_medium=rss&amp;utm_campaign=J2W_RSS</guid></item><item><title><![CDATA[Intern - Safety, Health & Environment (Sezzadio, IT)]]></title><description><![CDATA[<p style="text-align:center"> </p>
<p style="text-align:center"><span style="font-size:12.0pt"><em>At Tetra Pak we commit to making food safe and available, everywhere; and we protect what's good – protecting food, protecting people, and protecting the planet. By doing so we touch millions of people's lives every day. </em></span></p>
<p style="text-align:center"><span style="font-size:12.0pt"><em>And we need people like you to make it happen.</em></span></p>
<p style="text-align:center"><span style="font-size:12.0pt"><strong><em>We empower you to reach your potential with opportunities to make an impact to be proud of – for food, people and the planet.</em></strong></span></p><div><div style="padding:10.0px 0.0px;border:1.0px solid transparent"><div style="font-size:16.0px;word-wrap:break-word"><H2 style="font-size:1.0em;margin:0.0px"><b>Job Summary</b></H2></div><div><p>We are looking for an intern to support the Health, Safety and Environmental team in Tetra Pak, contributing to the implementation and maintenance of the World Class Manufacturing (WCM) methodology, with a focus on Safety and Health and Environment. You will deal with organization and presentation to internal and external auditors. You will cooperate with several stakeholders, including Production, Quality and Maintenance, building your knowledge on how the cap is produced. This is a <strong>six-month paid</strong> curricular internship position based in Tetra Pak Closure Italy in <strong>Sezzadio </strong>(AL), Italy.</p></div></div><div style="padding:10.0px 0.0px;border:1.0px solid transparent"><div style="font-size:16.0px;word-wrap:break-word"><H2 style="font-size:1.0em;margin:0.0px"><b>What you will do</b></H2></div><div><ul>
<li>Support daily HSE activities, including incident and recurrence management</li>
<li>Participating in WCM pillars and continuous improvement initiatives focused on safety and environmental performance</li>
<li>Assist in monitoring and analyzing HSE KPIs (safety, compliance, environmental indicators)</li>
<li>Contribute to loss analysis (incidents, near misses, environmental impacts) and support corrective/preventive actions</li>
<li>Support development of HSE data collection, reporting, and analysis tools</li>
<li>Assist in identifying opportunities to improve workplace safety, reduce environmental impact, and minimize waste</li>
<li>Provide administrative support to HSE</li>
</ul></div></div><div style="padding:10.0px 0.0px;border:1.0px solid transparent"><div style="font-size:16.0px;word-wrap:break-word"><H2 style="font-size:1.0em;margin:0.0px"><b>We believe you have</b></H2></div><div><ul>
<li>Degree (or currently pursuing) in in “Tecniche della prevenzione nell'ambiente e nei luoghi di lavoro” or “Environmental Engineering” or similar</li>
<li>Strong interest in Health, Safety &amp; Environment topics</li>
<li>Good analytical skills and familiarity with data analysis tools (e.g., Excel)</li>
<li>Fluency in English and Italian (written and spoken)</li>
<li>Knowledge of HSE regulations</li>
<li>Knowledge of ISO 45000 and ISO 14000 Management Systems or WCM principles is a plus</li>
</ul></div></div></div><p><span style="font-size:16.0px"><strong>We Offer You</strong></span></p>
<ul>
<li style="font-size:12.0pt"><span style="font-size:12.0pt">A variety of exciting challenges with ample opportunities for development and training in a truly global landscape</span></li>
<li style="font-size:12.0pt"><span style="font-size:12.0pt">A culture that pioneers a spirit of innovation where our industry experts drive visible results</span></li>
<li style="font-size:12.0pt"><span style="font-size:12.0pt">An equal opportunity employment experience that values diversity and inclusion</span></li>
<li style="font-size:12.0pt"><span style="font-size:12.0pt">Market competitive compensation and benefits with flexible working arrangements</span></li>
</ul>
<p> </p>
<p><span style="font-size:16.0px"><strong>Apply Now</strong></span></p>
<p><span style="font-size:12.0pt">If you are inspired to be part of our promise to protect what’s good; for food, people, and the planet, apply through our careers page at <a href="https://jobs.tetrapak.com/" target="_blank" rel="noopener">https://jobs.tetrapak.com/</a>. </span></p>
<p><span style="font-size:12.0pt">This job posting expires on<strong> 5th November 2026.</strong></span></p>
<p><span style="font-size:14.0px"><em>Diversity, equity, and inclusion is an everyday part of how we work. We give people a place to belong and support to thrive, an environment where everyone can be comfortable being themselves and has equal opportunities to grow and succeed. We embrace difference, celebrate people for who they are, and for the diversity they bring that helps us better understand and connect with our customers and communities worldwide.</em></span></p>
<p><span style="font-size:10.0pt"><em>If you require a reasonable accommodation to complete an application, participate in an interview, undergo an assessment, or engage in any part of the selection process, please complete this request form: <a id="menur1j4l" title="https://forms.office.com/pages/responsepage.aspx?id=snns0sxhi0iwki4oj9vuzl0dqwtpmkpjmbi9gex6arpun1jsnfpqtvu1rznlu0dpqjfwuk1rmu9asc4u&amp;route=shorturl" href="https://forms.office.com/pages/responsepage.aspx?id=SnnS0sxhI0iWkI4oj9VUzL0DQWtpMkpJmbI9gEX6arpUN1JSNFpQTVU1RzNLU0dPQjFWUk1RMU9aSC4u&amp;route=shorturl" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer noopener">Accommodation Request</a>. </em></span></p>
<p><span style="font-size:10.0pt"><em>Our Careers site has a dedicated page to DEI - <a id="menur1j4n" title="https://www.tetrapak.com/about-tetra-pak/careers/people-and-culture/diversity-equity-and-inclusion" href="https://www.tetrapak.com/about-tetra-pak/careers/people-and-culture/diversity-equity-and-inclusion" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer noopener">Diversity, equity and inclusion | Tetra Pak Global</a>. </em></span></p>]]></description><pubDate>Fri, 23 Oct 2026 2:00:00 GMT</pubDate><link>https://jobs.tetrapak.com/job/Sezzadio-Intern-Safety%2C-Health-&amp;-Environment/1419073933/?feedId=null&amp;utm_source=J2WRSS&amp;utm_medium=rss&amp;utm_campaign=J2W_RSS</link><guid>https://jobs.tetrapak.com/job/Sezzadio-Intern-Safety%2C-Health-&amp;-Environment/1419073933/?feedId=null&amp;utm_source=J2WRSS&amp;utm_medium=rss&amp;utm_campaign=J2W_RSS</guid></item><item><title><![CDATA[Marketing Manager (Utrecht, NL)]]></title><description><![CDATA[<p style="text-align:center"> </p>
<p style="text-align:center"><span style="font-size:12.0pt"><em>At Tetra Pak we commit to making food safe and available, everywhere; and we protect what's good – protecting food, protecting people, and protecting the planet. By doing so we touch millions of people's lives every day. </em></span></p>
<p style="text-align:center"><span style="font-size:12.0pt"><em>And we need people like you to make it happen.</em></span></p>
<p style="text-align:center"><span style="font-size:12.0pt"><strong><em>We empower you to reach your potential with opportunities to make an impact to be proud of – for food, people and the planet.</em></strong></span></p><div><div style="padding:10.0px 0.0px;border:1.0px solid transparent"><div style="font-size:16.0px;word-wrap:break-word"><H2 style="font-size:1.0em;margin:0.0px"><b>Job Summary</b></H2></div><div><p><span style="font-size:12.0pt">We have an excellent opportunity for a driven and experienced candidate to join a world-class business in the role of<strong> Marketing Manager.</strong> </span></p>
<p><span style="font-size:12.0pt"> </span><br><span style="font-size:12.0pt">The location can be either <strong>Utrecht, the Netherlands or Groot-Bijgaarden, Belgium.</strong> </span><br><span style="font-size:12.0pt"> </span></p>
<p><span style="font-size:12.0pt">Eventual travel within our France and Benelux Market, primarily in Benelux (maximum 20% of the working time), might be required. </span></p></div></div><div style="padding:10.0px 0.0px;border:1.0px solid transparent"><div style="font-size:16.0px;word-wrap:break-word"><H2 style="font-size:1.0em;margin:0.0px"><b>What you will do</b></H2></div><div><p><span style="font-size:12.0pt">As Marketing Manager, you will be responsible and accountable for driving Marketing activities within France &amp; Benelux. You will work with customers to further drive Tetra Pak’s business by deploying a marketing services program as suitable per customer around Portfolio Deployment, Sustainability, and Communication.   <br></span><br><span style="font-size:12.0pt">Your key stakeholders will be Sales, Marketing, Communication, Sustainability, Global &amp; European colleagues, as well as Marketing Directors and Managers of customers, as well as Marketing and communication agency suppliers.  <br><br></span><span style="font-size:12.0pt">Please note that this role does not involve people management responsibilities; instead, it is primarily an operational position with transversal management aspects.<br><br></span><span style="font-size:12.0pt"><strong>Responsibilities: </strong>  </span></p>
<p><span style="font-size:12.0pt">Pillar #1: Growth with existing &amp; new customers  </span></p>
<ul>
<li><span style="font-size:12.0pt">Participate in the development of the Market Business Plan based on analysis of the market covering the entire value chain in identified priority categories. </span></li>
<li><span style="font-size:12.0pt">Participate in identifying market growth initiatives aligned with the cluster Europe &amp; Central Asia growth strategy, deploy and execute initiatives. </span></li>
<li><span style="font-size:12.0pt">Identify new product requirements based on value chain needs in key categories. Champion these requirements with the team and the Regional/Central Product organization.  </span></li>
<li><span style="font-size:12.0pt">Work closely with customers to secure alignment and deliver best customer value incl. marketing services for key customers. </span></li>
<li><span style="font-size:12.0pt">Manage Market Promotional Investment for all marketing activities spent and follow up and control by rules and processes. </span></li>
</ul>
<p><span style="font-size:12.0pt"><br>Pillar #2: Sustainability  </span></p>
<ul>
<li><span style="font-size:12.0pt">Participate and lead specific cross-border projects and meetings within France &amp; Benelux around the topic of sustainability. </span></li>
<li><span style="font-size:12.0pt">Contribute to sustainable portfolio deployment throughout our 3 businesses : Packaging, Processing and Services. </span></li>
</ul>
<p><span style="font-size:12.0pt"><br>Pillar#3: Drive lead generation, conversion and opportunity management  </span></p>
<ul>
<li><span style="font-size:12.0pt">Participate in Marketing lead generation and management, through customer interactions and marketing automation related activities.  </span></li>
<li><span style="font-size:12.0pt">Monitor business pipeline to reach 3Y ambition in defined growth initiatives. </span></li>
</ul></div></div><div style="padding:10.0px 0.0px;border:1.0px solid transparent"><div style="font-size:16.0px;word-wrap:break-word"><H2 style="font-size:1.0em;margin:0.0px"><b>We believe you have</b></H2></div><div><ul>
<li style="font-size:12.0pt"><span style="font-size:12.0pt">At least 3-5 years of Marketing Experience, preferably gained as a product or sales or marketing manager, within a company where sustainability is essential. </span></li>
<li style="font-size:12.0pt"><span style="font-size:12.0pt">You have experience in B2B and/or B2C marketing and your understanding of the FMCG marketing principles counts as a big plus. </span></li>
<li style="font-size:12.0pt"><span style="font-size:12.0pt">Education-wise, you are fully trained and have obtained a university/college degree or MBA or equivalent qualification in the Marketing discipline. </span></li>
<li style="font-size:12.0pt"><span style="font-size:12.0pt">You are fully fluent in English and Dutch. </span></li>
<li style="font-size:12.0pt"><span style="font-size:12.0pt">Your computer literacy (Excel, Word, PowerPoint) is sufficient for the role.  </span></li>
<li style="font-size:12.0pt"><span style="font-size:12.0pt">As a character, you are energetic, resilient, and have and have a curious mind. </span></li>
<li style="font-size:12.0pt"><span style="font-size:12.0pt">You understand the importance of strategic work and take ownership of valuable management and execution of projects. </span></li>
<li style="font-size:12.0pt"><span style="font-size:12.0pt">You have strong communication skills, equally adaptable in written/verbal communication and presentation situations. </span></li>
<li style="font-size:12.0pt"><span style="font-size:12.0pt">You can engage people on all levels, and you are strong in stakeholder management. You can demonstrate strength in analyzing data and formulating recommendations. </span></li>
<li style="font-size:12.0pt"><span style="font-size:12.0pt">Your strong project management skills can help you to effectively support the organization in achieving business targets. </span></li>
<li style="font-size:12.0pt"><span style="font-size:12.0pt">You will be visiting customers, primarily in France &amp; Benelux. Some travel expected to Italy and Sweden. </span></li>
<li style="font-size:12.0pt"><span style="font-size:12.0pt">Finally, sustainability is important for you on all levels.  </span></li>
</ul>
<p> </p>
<p><span style="font-size:12.0pt">If you have all these skills and experience, we are willing to support you to succeed in this role grow within our organization, and stay with us in the long run.</span></p></div></div></div><p><span style="font-size:16.0px"><strong>We Offer You</strong></span></p>
<ul>
<li style="font-size:12.0pt"><span style="font-size:12.0pt">A variety of exciting challenges with ample opportunities for development and training in a truly global landscape</span></li>
<li style="font-size:12.0pt"><span style="font-size:12.0pt">A culture that pioneers a spirit of innovation where our industry experts drive visible results</span></li>
<li style="font-size:12.0pt"><span style="font-size:12.0pt">An equal opportunity employment experience that values diversity and inclusion</span></li>
<li style="font-size:12.0pt"><span style="font-size:12.0pt">Market competitive compensation and benefits with flexible working arrangements</span></li>
</ul>
<p> </p>
<p><span style="font-size:16.0px"><strong>Apply Now</strong></span></p>
<p><span style="font-size:12.0pt">If you are inspired to be part of our promise to protect what’s good; for food, people, and the planet, apply through our careers page at <a href="https://jobs.tetrapak.com/" target="_blank" rel="noopener">https://jobs.tetrapak.com/</a>. </span></p>
<p> </p>
<p><span style="font-size:14.0px"><em>Diversity, equity, and inclusion is an everyday part of how we work. We give people a place to belong and support to thrive, an environment where everyone can be comfortable being themselves and has equal opportunities to grow and succeed. We embrace difference, celebrate people for who they are, and for the diversity they bring that helps us better understand and connect with our customers and communities worldwide.</em></span></p>
<p> </p>]]></description><pubDate>Fri, 23 Oct 2026 2:00:00 GMT</pubDate><link>https://jobs.tetrapak.com/job/Utrecht-Marketing-Manager/1419866933/?feedId=null&amp;utm_source=J2WRSS&amp;utm_medium=rss&amp;utm_campaign=J2W_RSS</link><guid>https://jobs.tetrapak.com/job/Utrecht-Marketing-Manager/1419866933/?feedId=null&amp;utm_source=J2WRSS&amp;utm_medium=rss&amp;utm_campaign=J2W_RSS</guid></item><item><title><![CDATA[Supply Network Specialist (Lund, SE)]]></title><description><![CDATA[<p style="text-align:center"> </p>
<p style="text-align:center"><span style="font-size:12.0pt"><em>At Tetra Pak we commit to making food safe and available, everywhere; and we protect what's good – protecting food, protecting people, and protecting the planet. By doing so we touch millions of people's lives every day. </em></span></p>
<p style="text-align:center"><span style="font-size:12.0pt"><em>And we need people like you to make it happen.</em></span></p>
<p style="text-align:center"><span style="font-size:12.0pt"><strong><em>We empower you to reach your potential with opportunities to make an impact to be proud of – for food, people and the planet.</em></strong></span></p><div><div style="padding:10.0px 0.0px;border:1.0px solid transparent"><div style="font-size:16.0px;word-wrap:break-word"><H2 style="font-size:1.0em;margin:0.0px"><b>Job Summary</b></H2></div><div><p style="line-height:15.0pt;margin:0.0cm;font-size:12.0pt;font-family:Aptos, sans-serif"><span style="font-size:11.0pt;color:black">Are you up for journey to transform a world class supply chain into a world class supply network? <strong>This role requires a unique combination of strong stakeholder influence and sharp analytical capability—if you enjoy both, this could be the right opportunity for you.</strong></span></p>
<p style="margin:0.0cm;font-size:12.0pt;font-family:Aptos, sans-serif"> </p>
<p style="line-height:15.0pt;margin:0.0cm;font-size:12.0pt;font-family:Aptos, sans-serif"><span style="font-size:11.0pt;color:black">We are now looking for a Supply Network Specialist to join the Supply Optimisation team within Services Supply Network (SSN) and operate in a global context. The position is permanent and you will be based in Lund, Sweden. </span></p>
<p style="margin:0.0cm;font-size:12.0pt;font-family:Aptos, sans-serif"> </p>
<p style="margin:0.0cm;font-size:12.0pt;font-family:Aptos, sans-serif"><span style="font-size:11.0pt;color:black">Services Supply Networks main task is to secure the best customer experience by optimizing and securing optimal availability of spare parts, consumables and upgrades for our global customers via our network of distribution centres located in Lund, Shanghai, Dubai, Chicago, Buenos Aires, Mexico City, Sao Paulo and Chakan.</span></p></div></div><div style="padding:10.0px 0.0px;border:1.0px solid transparent"><div style="font-size:16.0px;word-wrap:break-word"><H2 style="font-size:1.0em;margin:0.0px"><b>What you will do</b></H2></div><div><p style="line-height:15.0pt;margin:0.0cm;font-size:12.0pt;font-family:Aptos, sans-serif"><span style="font-size:11.0pt;color:black">As a Supply Network Specialist, you play a key role in driving supplier performance and improving the end‑to‑end supply network. Success in this role is built on two equally important dimensions: <strong>your ability to influence across the supply chain and your strength in analytical problem solving</strong>.</span></p>
<p style="line-height:15.0pt;margin:0.0cm;font-size:12.0pt;font-family:Aptos, sans-serif"><span style="font-size:11.0pt;color:black">You will work closely with supplier management, replenishment teams, and suppliers to translate business priorities into clear actions and expectations—ensuring alignment and driving tangible improvements in performance.</span></p>
<p style="margin:0.0cm;font-size:12.0pt;font-family:Aptos, sans-serif"> </p>
<ul style="margin-top:0.0cm;margin-bottom:0.0cm" type="disc">
<li style="color:black;line-height:15.0pt;margin-top:0.0cm;margin-right:0.0cm;margin-bottom:0.0cm;font-size:12.0pt;font-family:Aptos, sans-serif"><span style="font-size:11.0pt">Analyze supply and supplier performance to identify patterns, risks, and improvement opportunities</span></li>
<li style="color:black;line-height:15.0pt;margin-top:0.0cm;margin-right:0.0cm;margin-bottom:0.0cm;font-size:12.0pt;font-family:Aptos, sans-serif"><span style="font-size:11.0pt">Drive initiatives to improve delivery precision, reduce lead times, and strengthen supply reliability</span></li>
<li style="color:black;line-height:15.0pt;margin-top:0.0cm;margin-right:0.0cm;margin-bottom:0.0cm;font-size:12.0pt;font-family:Aptos, sans-serif"><span style="font-size:11.0pt">Translate business needs into concrete actions and requirements for suppliers, and follow through to secure results</span></li>
<li style="color:black;line-height:15.0pt;margin-top:0.0cm;margin-right:0.0cm;margin-bottom:0.0cm;font-size:12.0pt;font-family:Aptos, sans-serif"><span style="font-size:11.0pt">Influence and challenge stakeholders across functions and seniority levels to drive end‑to‑end optimization</span></li>
<li style="color:black;line-height:15.0pt;margin-top:0.0cm;margin-right:0.0cm;margin-bottom:0.0cm;font-size:12.0pt;font-family:Aptos, sans-serif"><span style="font-size:11.0pt">Support supplier management with data-driven insights in supplier development and negotiations</span></li>
<li style="color:black;line-height:15.0pt;margin-top:0.0cm;margin-right:0.0cm;margin-bottom:0.0cm;font-size:12.0pt;font-family:Aptos, sans-serif"><span style="font-size:11.0pt">Develop and implement structured problem-solving approaches (e.g. WCM) to address performance gaps</span></li>
<li style="color:black;line-height:15.0pt;margin-top:0.0cm;margin-right:0.0cm;margin-bottom:0.0cm;font-size:12.0pt;font-family:Aptos, sans-serif"><span style="font-size:11.0pt">Utilize and continuously improve planning systems, tools and ways of working within SSN</span></li>
</ul></div></div><div style="padding:10.0px 0.0px;border:1.0px solid transparent"><div style="font-size:16.0px;word-wrap:break-word"><H2 style="font-size:1.0em;margin:0.0px"><b>We believe you have</b></H2></div><div><p style="line-height:15.0pt;margin:0.0cm;font-size:12.0pt;font-family:Aptos, sans-serif"> </p>
<ul style="margin-top:0.0cm;margin-bottom:0.0cm" type="disc">
<li style="color:black;line-height:15.0pt;margin-top:0.0cm;margin-right:0.0cm;margin-bottom:0.0cm;font-size:12.0pt;font-family:Aptos, sans-serif"><span style="font-size:11.0pt">A university degree in a relevant field or equivalent experience</span></li>
<li style="color:black;line-height:15.0pt;margin-top:0.0cm;margin-right:0.0cm;margin-bottom:0.0cm;font-size:12.0pt;font-family:Aptos, sans-serif"><span style="font-size:11.0pt">3+ years of experience within supply chain, supply network, inventory management or supplier management</span></li>
<li style="color:black;line-height:15.0pt;margin-top:0.0cm;margin-right:0.0cm;margin-bottom:0.0cm;font-size:12.0pt;font-family:Aptos, sans-serif"><span style="font-size:11.0pt">A strong analytical mindset with the ability to identify patterns and draw actionable conclusions</span></li>
<li style="color:black;line-height:15.0pt;margin-top:0.0cm;margin-right:0.0cm;margin-bottom:0.0cm;font-size:12.0pt;font-family:Aptos, sans-serif"><span style="font-size:11.0pt">A structured approach to problem solving (e.g. WCM or similar methodologies)</span></li>
<li style="color:black;line-height:15.0pt;margin-top:0.0cm;margin-right:0.0cm;margin-bottom:0.0cm;font-size:12.0pt;font-family:Aptos, sans-serif"><span style="font-size:11.0pt">Advanced skills in Excel and experience working with large datasets</span></li>
<li style="color:black;line-height:15.0pt;margin-top:0.0cm;margin-right:0.0cm;margin-bottom:0.0cm;font-size:12.0pt;font-family:Aptos, sans-serif"><span style="font-size:11.0pt">Experience in Power BI; knowledge of SAP and Kinaxis Maestro is a plus</span></li>
<li style="color:black;line-height:15.0pt;margin-top:0.0cm;margin-right:0.0cm;margin-bottom:0.0cm;font-size:12.0pt;font-family:Aptos, sans-serif"><span style="font-size:11.0pt">Basic programming skills (e.g. DAX or Python) are considered an advantage</span></li>
<li style="color:black;line-height:15.0pt;margin-top:0.0cm;margin-right:0.0cm;margin-bottom:0.0cm;font-size:12.0pt;font-family:Aptos, sans-serif"><span style="font-size:11.0pt">Fluency in English, both written and spoken<br><br></span></li>
</ul>
<p style="line-height:15.0pt;margin:0.0cm;font-size:12.0pt;font-family:Aptos, sans-serif"><span style="font-size:11.0pt;color:black"><span style="font-size:11.0pt;color:black">To succeed in this role, you combine strong analytical capability with the confidence and credibility to influence others. <p style="text-align:center"><span style="font-size:12.0pt"><em>At Tetra Pak we commit to making food safe and available, everywhere; and we protect what's good – protecting food, protecting people, and protecting the planet. By doing so we touch millions of people's lives every day. </em></span></p>
<p style="text-align:center"><span style="font-size:12.0pt"><em>And we need people like you to make it happen.</em></span></p>
<p style="text-align:center"><span style="font-size:12.0pt"><strong><em>We empower you to reach your potential with opportunities to make an impact to be proud of – for food, people and the planet.</em></strong></span></p><div><div style="padding:10.0px 0.0px;border:1.0px solid transparent"><div style="font-size:16.0px;word-wrap:break-word"><H2 style="font-size:1.0em;margin:0.0px"><b>Job Summary</b></H2></div><div><p>We are looking for a Supply Chain Analyst (Back Office Customer Services Representative) to deliver best in class customer experience by driving operational and quality excellence across our shared service center. In this role, you will lead and develop a team of back-office specialists, secure timely and accurate order fulfilment, and translate customer needs into impactful, time-bound actions. If you enjoy solving complex challenges, empowering people, and finding smarter, simpler ways of working, this could be the right next step for you.<br>Make an impact to be proud of – for food, people and the planet.<br>This position is based on Queretaro, Mexico and reports to Customer Service Team Leader</p></div></div><div style="padding:10.0px 0.0px;border:1.0px solid transparent"><div style="font-size:16.0px;word-wrap:break-word"><H2 style="font-size:1.0em;margin:0.0px"><b>What you will do</b></H2></div><div><p>As Supply Chain Analyst (Back Office Customer Services Representative), you will:</p>
<p> </p>
<p><strong>Enabling Sales Management Operations</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Secure a reliable and efficient supply chain for Packaging Material (PM) and Additional Material (AM) order fulfilment by securing design master data, and ensuring effective order and delivery management, and invoicing workflows.</li>
<li>Respond to operational requests for documentation such as delivery notes, proforma invoices, Certificates of Analysis, and other required materials.</li>
<li>Prioritize and manage back‑office activities logged in Salesforce, providing timely responses to customers when needed.</li>
<li> </li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Operational Performance and Execution</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Contribute to increased operational productivity through proactive problem solving and continuous improvement.</li>
<li>Participate in or lead Continuous Improvement teams to identify productivity opportunities in processes and tools, in collaboration with the factory Continuous Improvement office.</li>
<li>Support focused KPI loss deployment to strengthen performance visibility and drive action.</li>
<li>Build strong collaboration with internal partners such as Front Office Supply Chain, Planning, and Logistics to ensure smooth order handling and consistently high service levels.</li>
<li>Escalate to Front Office Supply Chain when clarification or direct customer contact is required.</li>
</ul>
<p> </p>
<p><strong>Customer Experience</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Drive continuous improvement of back‑office activities using data analytics and a proactive mindset to enhance quality.</li>
<li>Participate in customer improvement initiatives initiated by Front Office Supply Chain, contributing your insights and expertise.</li>
<li>Liaise with factories and Integrated Supply Chain teams to represent the voice of the customer and expedite issue resolution when needed.</li>
</ul></div></div><div style="padding:10.0px 0.0px;border:1.0px solid transparent"><div style="font-size:16.0px;word-wrap:break-word"><H2 style="font-size:1.0em;margin:0.0px"><b>We believe you have</b></H2></div><div><ul>
<li>Experience in supply chain, customer service, order fulfilment, or a similar environment through work, internships, placements, apprenticeships, or early career roles. Candidates at the beginning of their career journey are encouraged to apply.</li>
<li>Strong coordination and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple requests, balance priorities, and maintain accuracy in a fast‑moving operational context.</li>
<li>Confidence working with digital systems such as ERP, order management platforms, or CRM tools (experience with Salesforce is an advantage but not required).</li>
<li>The ability to understand processes end‑to‑end and spot opportunities to simplify, standardize, or automate daily tasks.</li>
<li>Effective communication skills allow you to collaborate smoothly across different and remote teams.</li>
<li>Effective communication in English with cross border teams.</li>
<li>A proactive, problem‑solving mindset with curiosity to challenge existing ways of working and contribute to continuous improvement.</li>
<li>An inclusive, open, and collaborative approach, valuing diverse perspectives and contributing to a supportive team culture. </li>
</ul></div></div></div><p> </p>
<p><span style="font-size:12.0pt"><strong>We Offer You</strong></span></p>

<ul>
<li style="font-size:12.0pt"><span style="font-size:12.0pt">A variety of exciting challenges with ample opportunities for development and training in a truly global landscape</span></li>

</ul>

<p style="text-align:center"><span style="font-size:12.0pt"><em>At Tetra Pak we commit to making food safe and available, everywhere; and we protect what's good – protecting food, protecting people, and protecting the planet. By doing so we touch millions of people's lives every day. </em></span></p>
<p style="text-align:center"><span style="font-size:12.0pt"><em>And we need people like you to make it happen.</em></span></p>
<p style="text-align:center"><span style="font-size:12.0pt"><strong><em>We empower you to reach your potential with opportunities to make an impact to be proud of – for food, people and the planet.</em></strong></span></p><div><div style="padding:10.0px 0.0px;border:1.0px solid transparent"><div style="font-size:16.0px;word-wrap:break-word"><H2 style="font-size:1.0em;margin:0.0px"><b>Job Summary</b></H2></div><div><p>We are looking for a Supply Chain Team Leader (Back Office Customer Services Team Leader) to deliver best in class customer experience by driving operational and quality excellence across our shared service center. In this role, you will lead and develop a team of back-office specialists, secure timely and accurate order fulfilment, and translate customer needs into impactful, time-bound actions. If you enjoy solving complex challenges, empowering people, and finding smarter, simpler ways of working, this could be the right next step for you.<br>Make an impact to be proud of – for food, people and the planet.<br>This position is based on Queretaro, Mexico and reports to CSR BO Shared Service Center Manager </p></div></div><div style="padding:10.0px 0.0px;border:1.0px solid transparent"><div style="font-size:16.0px;word-wrap:break-word"><H2 style="font-size:1.0em;margin:0.0px"><b>What you will do</b></H2></div><div><p>As Supply Chain Team Leader (Back Office Customer Services Team Leader), you will:</p>
<p> </p>
<p><strong>Enabling Sales Management Operations</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Secure timely and accurate order fulfilment throughout the supply chain by securing design master data and ensuring effective packaging material and additional material order management.</li>
<li>Prioritize and allocate back-office activities according to workload, business criticality, and customer impact, ensuring the right escalation flow.</li>
<li>Support the team in complex operational situations and negotiation points between different stakeholders</li>
<li>Ensure compliance with global controls and standardized processes and support internal or external audits linked to back-office customer services operations.</li>
</ul>
<p> </p>
<p><strong>People Management</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Ensure the organization, competence, and capacity of the back-office customer service team are aligned to business needs.</li>
<li>Build strong development plans, fostering continuous learning, inclusion, and empowerment within the team.</li>
<li>Provide day to day coaching, guidance, and on the job training to support individual growth and team performance.</li>
<li>Create an environment where diverse perspectives are valued and people feel safe to bring new ideas and challenge existing processes.</li>
</ul>
<p> </p>
<p><strong>Operational Performance and Execution</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Ensure strong alignment between supply chain operations and market strategies.</li>
<li>Build and maintain collaborative environment with all departments involved in the customer services process in order to enable smooth order handling and high service levels.</li>
<li>Act as the local order management process driver for the Shared Service Centre site you lead, ensuring consistency and efficiency.</li>
<li>Drive the implementation of global and local projects that enhance back-office customer services operations and operational effectiveness.</li>
<li>Lead World Class Manufacturing (WCM) activities within the team, focusing on productivity improvements in tools, workflows, and ways of working in alignment with the factory WCM office.</li>
<li>Ensure that topics impacting operational performance or productivity are timely discussed with markets, factories, or Integrated Supply Chain (ISC) teams to ensure service levels are maintained with quality.</li>
</ul>
<p> </p>
<p><strong>Customer Experience</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Drive smooth, accurate, and timely order management processes that ensure a high-quality customer experience.</li>
<li>Actively track service levels and lead continuous improvement initiatives using defined data analytics.</li>
<li>Liaise with factories and ISC teams, representing the voice of the customer and ensuring escalations are resolved with speed and clarity.</li>
</ul>
<p> </p>
<p><strong>Commercial Compliance</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Understand and comply with Tetra Pak’s commercial practices framework, including pricing governance, contract terms, authorization matrices, and applicable regulatory frameworks, while following our global Code of Conduct.</li>
</ul></div></div><div style="padding:10.0px 0.0px;border:1.0px solid transparent"><div style="font-size:16.0px;word-wrap:break-word"><H2 style="font-size:1.0em;margin:0.0px"><b>We believe you have</b></H2></div><div><ul>
<li>Ideally around 5 years of operational experience in supply chain, customer service, order fulfilment, or similar fields.</li>
<li>Relevant experience in team management or coordinating people </li>
<li>Proven project management skills, with the ability to lead initiatives, drive progress, and secure alignment across stakeholders.</li>
<li>Excellent stakeholder management, with the ability to balance priorities, communicate clearly, and collaborate effectively across markets, factories, and internal teams.</li>
<li>Strong English communication skills, both written and verbal.</li>
<li>University degree</li>
<li>A structured way of working, with the ability to oversee multiple operational flows and secure follow-through.</li>
<li>A proactive, improvement-oriented mindset, constantly looking for ways to simplify, automate, and enhance back-office processes.</li>
<li>A leadership style that promotes inclusion, empowerment, learning, and open communication.</li>
</ul></div></div></div><p> </p>
<p><span style="font-size:12.0pt"><strong>We Offer You</strong></span></p>
<p> </p>
<ul>
<li style="font-size:12.0pt"><span style="font-size:12.0pt">A variety of exciting challenges with ample opportunities for development and training in a truly global landscape</span></li>
<li style="font-size:12.0pt"><span style="font-size:12.0pt">A culture that pioneers a spirit of innovation where our industry experts drive visible results</span></li>
<li style="font-size:12.0pt"><span style="font-size:12.0pt">An equal opportunity employment experience that values diversity and inclusion</span></li>
<li style="font-size:12.0pt"><span style="font-size:12.0pt">Market competitive compensation and benefits with flexible working arrangements</span></li>
</ul>
<p> </p>
<p><span style="font-size:12.0pt"><strong>Apply Now</strong></span></p>

<p><span style="font-size:12.0pt">This job posting expires on<strong> November 5th, 2026.</strong></span></p>

<p style="text-align:center"> </p>

<p style="text-align:center"><span style="font-size:14.0px"><em>At Tetra Pak we commit to making food safe and available, everywhere; and we protect what's good – protecting food, protecting people, and protecting the planet. By doing so we touch millions of people's lives every day. </em></span></p>

<p style="text-align:center"><span style="font-size:14.0px"><em>And we need people like you to make it happen.</em></span></p>

<p style="text-align:center"><b><span style="font-size:14.0px"><em>We empower you to reach your potential with opportunities to  make an impact to be proud of – for food, people and the planet.</em></span></b></p>

<p style="text-align:center"> </p>
<div><div style="padding:10.0px 0.0px;border:1.0px solid transparent"><div style="font-size:16.0px;word-wrap:break-word"><H2 style="font-size:1.0em;margin:0.0px"><b>Forklift Operator</b></H2></div><div><p> </p>

<p>We are looking for a skilled Forklift Operator to join our team. In this role, you will play a crucial part in the logistics and material handling processes of our operations.</p>

<p> </p>

<p>Your primary responsibilities will include unloading raw materials from delivery trucks, loading trucks with customer order, receive products using scanning and computer systems. Also, ensure products are stored efficiently using the FIFO (First In, First Out) method and assist in delivering materials for production and preparing finished products for customer delivery.<br>
 </p>

<p> </p>
</div></div><div style="padding:10.0px 0.0px;border:1.0px solid transparent"><div style="font-size:16.0px;word-wrap:break-word"><H2 style="font-size:1.0em;margin:0.0px"><b>What you will do</b></H2></div><div><p> </p>

<ul>
	<li>Operate lift trucks safely and accurately to receive, store, stack, stage, handle, deliver, and ship materials and finished products.</li>
	<li>Conduct pre-operation safety inspections of the lift truck and complete the checklist prior to use.</li>
	<li>Participate in cycle counting to ensure accurate location and availability of materials.</li>
	<li>Understand and execute 5S principles to maintain a clean and organized work environment.</li>
	<li>Support long haul truck operations and administrative tasks as needed.</li>
	<li>Participate in continuous improvement initiatives to enhance warehouse operations and efficiency.</li>
	<li>Engage in sound warehouse practices to protect materials from damage and contamination.</li>
</ul>

<p><br>
 </p>
</div></div><div style="padding:10.0px 0.0px;border:1.0px solid transparent"><div style="font-size:16.0px;word-wrap:break-word"><H2 style="font-size:1.0em;margin:0.0px"><b>We believe you have</b></H2></div><div><p> </p>
<ul>
<li>High School Diploma or GED Preferred.</li>
<li>Minimum of 1 year experience operating sit-down or counter balanced trucks (preferred)</li>
<li>At least 1 year of experience in warehouse shipping and receiving. </li>
<li>Ability to be trained as an authorized operator; (OSHA standard 29CFR1910.178(1))</li>
<li>Basic computer skills</li>
<li>Strong dependability and reliability.</li>
<li>Ability to read and understand and comply with work directions, training manuals, safety rules, standard operating procedures, and World Class Manufacturing processes.</li>
</ul>
<p> </p>
<p> </p>
<p><strong>Shift schedule</strong></p>
<ul>

<li><strong>Work Pattern:</strong>  Alternating between 36 hrs/week and 48 hrs/week. Working every other weekend.</li>
</ul>

<p style="text-align:center"><span style="font-size:12.0pt"><em>At Tetra Pak we commit to making food safe and available, everywhere; and we protect what's good – protecting food, protecting people, and protecting the planet. By doing so we touch millions of people's lives every day. </em></span></p>
<p style="text-align:center"><span style="font-size:12.0pt"><em>And we need people like you to make it happen.</em></span></p>
<p style="text-align:center"><span style="font-size:12.0pt"><strong><em>We empower you to reach your potential with opportunities to make an impact to be proud of – for food, people and the planet.</em></strong></span></p><div><div style="padding:10.0px 0.0px;border:1.0px solid transparent"><div style="font-size:16.0px;word-wrap:break-word"><H2 style="font-size:1.0em;margin:0.0px"><b>Job Summary</b></H2></div><div><p>We are looking for a Back Office Customer Services Team Leader to deliver best in class customer experience by driving operational and quality excellence across our shared service centre. In this role, you will lead and develop a team of back office specialists, secure timely and accurate order fulfilment, and translate customer needs into impactful, time bound actions. If you enjoy solving complex challenges, empowering people, and finding smarter, simpler ways of working, this could be the right next step for you.</p>
<p><strong>Make an impact to be proud of – for food, people and the planet.</strong></p>
<p>The position is based in Binh Duong and reports to CSR BO Shared Service Center Manager.</p></div></div><div style="padding:10.0px 0.0px;border:1.0px solid transparent"><div style="font-size:16.0px;word-wrap:break-word"><H2 style="font-size:1.0em;margin:0.0px"><b>What you will do</b></H2></div><div><p>As Back Office Customer Services Team Leader, you will:</p>
<p><strong>Enabling Sales Management Operations</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Secure timely and accurate order fulfilment throughout the supply chain by securing design master data and ensuring effective packaging material and additional material order management.</li>
<li>Prioritize and allocate back office activities according to workload, business criticality, and customer impact, ensuring the right escalation flow.</li>
<li>Support the team in complex operational situations and negotiation points between different stakeholders</li>
<li>Ensure compliance with global controls and standardised processes and support internal or external audits linked to back office customer services operations.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>People Management</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Ensure the organization, competence, and capacity of the back office customer service team are aligned to business needs.</li>
<li>Build strong development plans, fostering continuous learning, inclusion, and empowerment within the team.</li>
<li>Provide day to day coaching, guidance, and on the job training to support individual growth and team performance.</li>
<li>Create an environment where diverse perspectives are valued and people feel safe to bring new ideas and challenge existing processes.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Operational Performance and Execution</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Ensure strong alignment between supply chain operations and market strategies.</li>
<li>Build and maintain collaborative environment with all departments involved in the customer services process in order to enable smooth order handling and high service levels.</li>
<li>Act as the local order management process driver for the Shared Service Centre site you lead, ensuring consistency and efficiency.</li>
<li>Drive the implementation of global and local projects that enhance back office customer services operations and operational effectiveness.</li>
<li>Lead World Class Manufacturing (WCM) activities within the team, focusing on productivity improvements in tools, workflows, and ways of working in alignment with the factory WCM office.</li>
<li>Ensure that topics impacting operational performance or productivity are timely discussed with markets, factories, or Integrated Supply Chain (ISC) teams to ensure service levels are maintained with quality.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Customer Experience</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Drive smooth, accurate, and timely order management processes that ensure a high quality customer experience.</li>
<li>Actively track service levels and lead continuous improvement initiatives using defined data analytics.</li>
<li>Liaise with factories and ISC teams, representing the voice of the customer and ensuring escalations are resolved with speed and clarity.</li>
</ul></div></div><div style="padding:10.0px 0.0px;border:1.0px solid transparent"><div style="font-size:16.0px;word-wrap:break-word"><H2 style="font-size:1.0em;margin:0.0px"><b>We believe you have</b></H2></div><div><ul>
<li>Ideally around 5 years of operational experience in supply chain, customer service, order fulfilment, or similar fields.</li>
<li>Relevant experience in team management or coordinating people</li>
<li>Proven project management skills, with the ability to lead initiatives, drive progress, and secure alignment across stakeholders.</li>
<li>Excellent stakeholder management, with the ability to balance priorities, communicate clearly, and collaborate effectively across markets, factories, and internal teams.</li>
<li>Strong English communication skills, both written and verbal.</li>
<li>University degree</li>
<li>A structured way of working, with the ability to oversee multiple operational flows and secure follow through.</li>
<li>A proactive, improvement oriented mindset, constantly looking for ways to simplify, automate, and enhance back office processes.</li>
<li>A leadership style that promotes inclusion, empowerment, learning, and open communication.</li>
</ul></div></div></div><p><span style="font-size:16.0px"><strong>We Offer You</strong></span></p>
<ul>
<li style="font-size:12.0pt"><span style="font-size:12.0pt">A variety of exciting challenges with ample opportunities for development and training in a truly global landscape</span></li>
<li style="font-size:12.0pt"><span style="font-size:12.0pt">A culture that pioneers a spirit of innovation where our industry experts drive visible results</span></li>
<li style="font-size:12.0pt"><span style="font-size:12.0pt">An equal opportunity employment experience that values diversity and inclusion</span></li>
<li style="font-size:12.0pt"><span style="font-size:12.0pt">Market competitive compensation and benefits with flexible working arrangements</span></li>
</ul>
<p> </p>
<p><span style="font-size:16.0px"><strong>Apply Now</strong></span></p>
<p><span style="font-size:12.0pt">If you are inspired to be part of our promise to protect what’s good; for food, people, and the planet, apply through our careers page at <a href="https://jobs.tetrapak.com/" target="_blank" rel="noopener">https://jobs.tetrapak.com/</a>. </span></p>
<p><span style="font-size:12.0pt">This job posting expires on<strong> 05 November 2026.</strong></span></p>
<p> </p>

We embrace difference, celebrate people for who they are, and for the diversity they bring that helps us better understand and connect with our customers and communities worldwide.</em></span></p>

<p style="text-align:center"><span style="font-size:12.0pt"><em>At Tetra Pak we commit to making food safe and available, everywhere; and we protect what's good – protecting food, protecting people, and protecting the planet. By doing so we touch millions of people's lives every day. </em></span></p>
<p style="text-align:center"><span style="font-size:12.0pt"><em>And we need people like you to make it happen.</em></span></p>
<p style="text-align:center"><span style="font-size:12.0pt"><strong><em>We empower you to reach your potential with opportunities to make an impact to be proud of – for food, people and the planet.</em></strong></span></p><div>
<div>
<p><strong>Job Summary</strong></p>
<p> </p>
<p>We are looking for a Supply Chain Coordinator to deliver best‑in‑class customer experience by driving operational and quality excellence across our supply chain.</p>
<p><em>The contractual position title is Back Office Customer Service Representative; Supply Chain Coordinator is used in this job description to better reflect the scope of the role.</em></p>
<p>In this role, you will secure timely and accurate order fulfilment while translating customer needs into clear, impactful actions. If you enjoy improving processes, simplifying ways of working, and identifying opportunities for automation, this could be the right next step for you.</p>
<p>Make an impact to be proud of – for food, people and the planet. </p>
</div>
<div>
<p>The position is based in Budaors. </p>
</div>
<div>
<p>  </p>
</div>
<div>
<p><strong>What you will do </strong></p>
<p> </p>
</div>
<div>
<p>As Supply Chain Coordinator, you will: </p>
</div>
<div>
<p> Enabling Sales Management Process </p>
</div>
<div>
<ul style="list-style-type:disc">
<li>
<p>Secure a reliable and efficient supply chain for Packaging Material (PM) and Additional Material (AM) order fulfilment by securing design master data, and ensuring effective order and delivery management, and invoicing workflows. </p>
</li>
</ul>
</div>
<div>
<ul style="list-style-type:disc">
<li>
<p>Respond to operational requests for documentation such as delivery notes, proforma invoices, Certificates of Analysis, and other required materials. </p>
</li>
</ul>
</div>
<div>
<ul style="list-style-type:disc">
<li>
<p>Prioritize and manage back‑office activities logged in Salesforce, providing timely responses to customers when needed. </p>
</li>
</ul>
</div>
<div>
<p> </p>
</div>
<div>
<p>Operational Performance and Execution </p>
</div>
<div>
<ul style="list-style-type:disc">
<li>
<p>Contribute to increased operational productivity through proactive problem solving and continuous improvement. </p>
</li>
</ul>
</div>
<div>
<ul style="list-style-type:disc">
<li>
<p>Participate in or lead Continuous Improvement teams to identify productivity opportunities in processes and tools, in collaboration with the factory Continuous Improvement office. </p>
</li>
</ul>
</div>
<div>
<ul style="list-style-type:disc">
<li>
<p>Support focused KPI loss deployment to strengthen performance visibility and drive action. </p>
</li>
</ul>
</div>
<div>
<ul style="list-style-type:disc">
<li>
<p>Build strong collaboration with internal partners such as Front Office Supply Chain, Planning, and Logistics to ensure smooth order handling and consistently high service levels. </p>
</li>
</ul>
</div>
<div>
<ul style="list-style-type:disc">
<li>
<p>Escalate to Front Office Supply Chain when clarification or direct customer contact is required. </p>
</li>
</ul>
</div>
<div>
<p> </p>
</div>
</div>
<div>
<div>
<p>Customer Experience </p>
</div>
<div>
<ul style="list-style-type:disc">
<li>
<p>Drive continuous improvement of back‑office activities using data analytics and a proactive mindset to enhance quality. </p>
</li>
</ul>
</div>
<div>
<ul style="list-style-type:disc">
<li>
<p>Participate in customer improvement initiatives initiated by Front Office Supply Chain, contributing your insights and expertise. </p>
</li>
</ul>
</div>
<div>
<ul style="list-style-type:disc">
<li>
<p>Liaise with factories and Integrated Supply Chain teams to represent the voice of the customer and expedite issue resolution when needed. </p>
</li>
</ul>
</div>
<div>
<p> </p>
</div>
<div>
<p><strong>We believe you have </strong></p>
<p> </p>
</div>
<div>
<ul style="list-style-type:disc">
<li>
<p>Experience in supply chain, customer service, order fulfilment, or a similar environment through work, internships, placements, apprenticeships, or early career roles. Candidates at the beginning of their career journey are encouraged to apply. </p>
</li>
</ul>
</div>
<div>
<ul style="list-style-type:disc">
<li>
<p>Strong coordination and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple requests, balance priorities, and maintain accuracy in a fast‑moving operational context. </p>
</li>
</ul>
</div>
<div>
<ul style="list-style-type:disc">
<li>
<p>Confidence working with digital systems such as ERP, order management platforms, or CRM tools (experience with Salesforce is an advantage but not required). </p>
</li>
</ul>
</div>
<div>
<ul style="list-style-type:disc">
<li>
<p>The ability to understand processes end‑to‑end and spot opportunities to simplify, standardize, or automate daily tasks. </p>
</li>
</ul>
</div>
<div>
<ul style="list-style-type:disc">
<li>
<p>Effective communication skills, allowing you to collaborate smoothly across different and remote teams. </p>
</li>
</ul>
</div>
<div>
<ul style="list-style-type:disc">
<li>
<p>Full fluency in English to enable effective communication with cross border teams. </p>
</li>
<li>Any other European language skills is considered as an advantage.</li>
</ul>
</div>
<div>
<ul style="list-style-type:disc">
<li>
<p>A proactive, problem‑solving mindset with curiosity to challenge existing ways of working and contribute to continuous improvement. </p>
</li>
</ul>
</div>
<div>
<ul style="list-style-type:disc">
<li>
<p>An inclusive, open, and collaborative approach, valuing diverse perspectives and contributing to a supportive team culture.</p>
</li>
</ul>
<p> </p>
</div>
</div><p><span style="font-size:16.0px"><strong>We Offer You</strong></span></p>
<p> </p>
<ul>
<li style="font-size:12.0pt"><span style="font-size:12.0pt">A variety of exciting challenges with ample opportunities for development and training in a truly global landscape</span></li>
<li style="font-size:12.0pt"><span style="font-size:12.0pt">A culture that pioneers a spirit of innovation where our industry experts drive visible results</span></li>
<li style="font-size:12.0pt"><span style="font-size:12.0pt">An equal opportunity employment experience that values diversity and inclusion</span></li>
<li style="font-size:12.0pt"><span style="font-size:12.0pt">Market competitive compensation and benefits with flexible working arrangements</span></li>
</ul>
<p> </p>
<p><span style="font-size:16.0px"><strong>Apply Now</strong></span></p>
<p><span style="font-size:12.0pt">If you are inspired to be part of our promise to protect what’s good; for food, people, and the planet, apply through our careers page at <a href="https://jobs.tetrapak.com/" target="_blank" rel="noopener">https://jobs.tetrapak.com/</a>. </span></p>
<p><span style="font-size:12.0pt">This job posting expires on<strong> 12th November 2026.</strong></span></p>
<p> </p>

We embrace difference, celebrate people for who they are, and for the diversity they bring that helps us better understand and connect with our customers and communities worldwide.</em></span></p>

<p style="text-align:center"><span style="font-size:12.0pt"><em>At Tetra Pak we commit to making food safe and available, everywhere; and we protect what's good – protecting food, protecting people, and protecting the planet. By doing so we touch millions of people's lives every day. </em></span></p>
<p style="text-align:center"><span style="font-size:12.0pt"><em>And we need people like you to make it happen.</em></span></p>
<p style="text-align:center"><span style="font-size:12.0pt"><strong><em>We empower you to reach your potential with opportunities to make an impact to be proud of – for food, people and the planet.</em></strong></span></p><div><div style="padding:10.0px 0.0px;border:1.0px solid transparent"><div style="font-size:16.0px;word-wrap:break-word"><H2 style="font-size:1.0em;margin:0.0px"><b>Job Summary</b></H2></div><div><p><span style="font-size:12.0pt">We are looking for a Back Office Customer Services Team Leader to deliver best‑in‑class customer experience by driving operational and quality excellence across our shared service centre. In this role, you will lead and develop a team of back‑office specialists, secure timely and accurate order fulfilment, and translate customer needs into impactful, time‑bound actions. If you enjoy solving complex challenges, empowering people, and finding smarter, simpler ways of working, this could be the right next step for you. </span></p>
<p><span style="font-size:12.0pt">Make an impact to be proud of – for food, people and the planet. </span></p>
<p><span style="font-size:12.0pt"> </span><br><span style="font-size:12.0pt">The position is based in Budaörs, Hungary and reports to <span>CSR BO Shared Service Center Manager</span> . </span></p></div></div><div style="padding:10.0px 0.0px;border:1.0px solid transparent"><div style="font-size:16.0px;word-wrap:break-word"><H2 style="font-size:1.0em;margin:0.0px"><b>What you will do</b></H2></div><div><p>As Back Office Customer Services Team Leader, you will: </p>
<p><strong>Enabling Sales Management Operations </strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Secure timely and accurate order fulfilment throughout the supply chain by securing design master data and ensuring effective packaging material and additional material order management. </li>
<li>Prioritize and allocate back‑office activities according to workload, business criticality, and customer impact, ensuring the right escalation flow. </li>
<li>Support the team in complex operational situations and negotiation points between different stakeholders </li>
<li>Ensure compliance with global controls and standardised processes and support internal or external audits linked to back‑office customer services operations. </li>
</ul>
<p><strong>People Management </strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Ensure the organization, competence, and capacity of the back‑office customer service team are aligned to business needs. </li>
<li>Build strong development plans, fostering continuous learning, inclusion, and empowerment within the team. </li>
<li>Provide day‑to‑day coaching, guidance, and on‑the‑job training to support individual growth and team performance. </li>
<li>Create an environment where diverse perspectives are valued and people feel safe to bring new ideas and challenge existing processes. </li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Operational Performance and Execution </strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Ensure strong alignment between supply chain operations and market strategies. </li>
<li>Build and maintain collaborative environment with all departments involved in the customer services process in order to enable smooth order handling and high service levels. </li>
<li>Act as the local order management process driver for the Shared Service Centre site you lead, ensuring consistency and efficiency. </li>
<li>Drive the implementation of global and local projects that enhance back‑office customer services operations and operational effectiveness. </li>
<li>Lead World Class Manufacturing (WCM) activities within the team, focusing on productivity improvements in tools, workflows, and ways of working in alignment with the factory WCM office. </li>
<li>Ensure that topics impacting operational performance or productivity are timely discussed with markets, factories, or Integrated Supply Chain (ISC) teams to ensure service levels are maintained with quality. </li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Customer Experience </strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Drive smooth, accurate, and timely order management processes that ensure a high‑quality customer experience. </li>
<li>Actively track service levels and lead continuous improvement initiatives using defined data analytics. </li>
<li>Liaise with factories and ISC teams, representing the voice of the customer and ensuring escalations are resolved with speed and clarity. </li>
</ul></div></div><div style="padding:10.0px 0.0px;border:1.0px solid transparent"><div style="font-size:16.0px;word-wrap:break-word"><H2 style="font-size:1.0em;margin:0.0px"><b>We believe you have</b></H2></div><div><ul>
<li style="font-size:12.0pt"><span style="font-size:12.0pt">Ideally around 5 years of operational experience in supply chain, customer service, order fulfilment, or similar fields. </span></li>
<li style="font-size:12.0pt"><span style="font-size:12.0pt">Relevant experience in team management or coordinating people  </span></li>
<li style="font-size:12.0pt"><span style="font-size:12.0pt">Proven project management skills, with the ability to lead initiatives, drive progress, and secure alignment across stakeholders. </span></li>
<li style="font-size:12.0pt"><span style="font-size:12.0pt">Excellent stakeholder management, with the ability to balance priorities, communicate clearly, and collaborate effectively across markets, factories, and internal teams. </span></li>
<li style="font-size:12.0pt"><span style="font-size:12.0pt">Strong English communication skills, both written and verbal. </span></li>
<li style="font-size:12.0pt"><span style="font-size:12.0pt">University degree </span></li>
<li style="font-size:12.0pt"><span style="font-size:12.0pt">A structured way of working, with the ability to oversee multiple operational flows and secure follow‑through. </span></li>
<li style="font-size:12.0pt"><span style="font-size:12.0pt">A proactive, improvement‑oriented mindset, constantly looking for ways to simplify, automate, and enhance back‑office processes. </span></li>
<li style="font-size:12.0pt"><span style="font-size:12.0pt">A leadership style that promotes inclusion, empowerment, learning, and open communication. </span></li>
</ul></div></div></div><p><span style="font-size:16.0px"><strong>We Offer You</strong></span></p>
<ul>
<li style="font-size:12.0pt"><span style="font-size:12.0pt">A variety of exciting challenges with ample opportunities for development and training in a truly global landscape</span></li>
<li style="font-size:12.0pt"><span style="font-size:12.0pt">A culture that pioneers a spirit of innovation where our industry experts drive visible results</span></li>
<li style="font-size:12.0pt"><span style="font-size:12.0pt">An equal opportunity employment experience that values diversity and inclusion</span></li>
<li style="font-size:12.0pt"><span style="font-size:12.0pt">Market competitive compensation and benefits with flexible working arrangements</span></li>
</ul>
<p> </p>
<p><span style="font-size:16.0px"><strong>Apply Now</strong></span></p>
<p><span style="font-size:12.0pt">If you are inspired to be part of our promise to protect what’s good; for food, people, and the planet, apply through our careers page at <a href="https://jobs.tetrapak.com/" target="_blank" rel="noopener">https://jobs.tetrapak.com/</a>. </span></p>
<p><span style="font-size:12.0pt">This job posting expires on<strong> 5th November 2026</strong>.</span></p>
<p><span style="font-size:12.0pt">If you have any questions about your application, please contact <strong>Veronika Parragi-Hurtony</strong>.</span></p>
<p> </p>
<p><span style="font-size:14.0px"><em>Diversity, equity, and inclusion is an everyday part of how we work. We give people a place to belong and support to thrive, an environment where everyone can be comfortable being themselves and has equal opportunities to grow and succeed. We embrace difference, celebrate people for who they are, and for the diversity they bring that helps us better understand and connect with our customers and communities worldwide.</em></span></p>
<p> </p>]]></description><pubDate>Thu, 22 Oct 2026 0:00:00 GMT</pubDate><link>https://jobs.tetrapak.com/job/Budaors-Back-Office-Customer-Service-Team-Leader/1450246133/?feedId=null&amp;utm_source=J2WRSS&amp;utm_medium=rss&amp;utm_campaign=J2W_RSS</link><guid>https://jobs.tetrapak.com/job/Budaors-Back-Office-Customer-Service-Team-Leader/1450246133/?feedId=null&amp;utm_source=J2WRSS&amp;utm_medium=rss&amp;utm_campaign=J2W_RSS</guid></item><item><title><![CDATA[Supply Chain Analyst (Back Office Customer Service Representative) (Monte Mor, SP, BR)]]></title><description><![CDATA[<p style="text-align:center"> </p>
<p style="text-align:center"><em>At Tetra Pak we commit to making food safe and available, everywhere; and we protect what's good – protecting food, protecting people, and protecting the planet. By doing so we touch millions of people's lives every day. </em></p>
<p style="text-align:center"><em>And we need people like you to make it happen.</em></p>
<p style="text-align:center"><em><strong>We empower you to reach your potential with opportunities to make an impact to be proud of – for food, people and the planet.</strong></em></p><div><div style="padding:10.0px 0.0px;border:1.0px solid transparent"><div style="font-size:16.0px;word-wrap:break-word"><H2 style="font-size:1.0em;margin:0.0px"><b>Job Summary</b></H2></div><div><p> </p>
<p>We are looking for a Back Office Customer Service Representative (Supply Chain Analyst) to deliver best‑in‑class customer experience by driving operational and quality excellence across our supply chain. In this role, you will secure timely and accurate order fulfilment while translating customer needs into clear, impactful actions. If you enjoy improving processes, simplifying ways of working, and identifying opportunities for automation, this could be the right next step for you. </p>
<p><br><strong>Make an impact to be proud of – for food, people and the planet. </strong></p>
<p> </p>
<p>The position is based in Monte Mor, São Paulo.</p></div></div><div style="padding:10.0px 0.0px;border:1.0px solid transparent"><div style="font-size:16.0px;word-wrap:break-word"><H2 style="font-size:1.0em;margin:0.0px"><b>What you will do</b></H2></div><div><p> </p>
<p>As Back Office Customer Service Representative (Supply Chain Analyst), you will: </p>
<p> </p>
<p><strong> Enabling Sales Management Process </strong></p>
<p> </p>
<ul>
<li>Secure a reliable and efficient supply chain for Packaging Material (PM) and Additional Material (AM) order fulfilment by securing design master data, and ensuring effective order and delivery management, and invoicing workflows;</li>
<li>Respond to operational requests for documentation such as delivery notes, proforma invoices, Certificates of Analysis, and other required materials;</li>
<li>Prioritize and manage back‑office activities logged in Salesforce, providing timely responses to customers when needed;</li>
</ul>
<p> </p>
<p><strong>Operational Performance and Execution <br><br></strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Contribute to increased operational productivity through proactive problem solving and continuous improvement;</li>
<li>Participate in or lead Continuous Improvement teams to identify productivity opportunities in processes and tools, in collaboration with the factory Continuous Improvement office;</li>
<li>Support focused KPI loss deployment to strengthen performance visibility and drive action;</li>
<li>Build strong collaboration with internal partners such as Front Office Supply Chain, Planning, and Logistics to ensure smooth order handling and consistently high service levels;</li>
<li>Escalate to Front Office Supply Chain when clarification or direct customer contact is required. </li>
</ul>
<p> </p>
<p><strong>Customer Experience </strong></p>
<p> </p>
<ul>
<li>Drive continuous improvement of back‑office activities using data analytics and a proactive mindset to enhance quality;</li>
<li>Participate in customer improvement initiatives initiated by Front Office Supply Chain, contributing your insights and expertise;</li>
<li>Liaise with factories and Integrated Supply Chain teams to represent the voice of the customer and expedite issue resolution when needed.</li>
</ul></div></div><div style="padding:10.0px 0.0px;border:1.0px solid transparent"><div style="font-size:16.0px;word-wrap:break-word"><H2 style="font-size:1.0em;margin:0.0px"><b>We believe you have</b></H2></div><div><p> </p>
<ul>
<li>Experience in supply chain, customer service, order fulfilment, or a similar environment through work, internships, placements, apprenticeships, or early career roles. Candidates at the beginning of their career journey are encouraged to apply;</li>
<li>Strong coordination and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple requests, balance priorities, and maintain accuracy in a fast‑moving operational context; </li>
<li>Confidence working with digital systems such as ERP, order management platforms, or CRM tools (experience with Salesforce is an advantage but not required);</li>
<li>The ability to understand processes end‑to‑end and spot opportunities to simplify, standardize, or automate daily tasks;</li>
<li>Effective communication skills, allowing you to collaborate smoothly across different and remote teams;</li>
<li>Effective communication in English with cross border teams;</li>
<li>A proactive, problem‑solving mindset with curiosity to challenge existing ways of working and contribute to continuous improvement;</li>
<li>An inclusive, open, and collaborative approach, valuing diverse perspectives and contributing to a supportive team culture.  </li>
</ul></div></div></div><p> </p>
<p><span style="font-size:12.0pt"><strong>We Offer You </strong></span></p>
<p> </p>
<ul>
<li>A variety of exciting challenges with ample opportunities for development and training in a truly global landscape. </li>
<li>A culture that pioneers a spirit of innovation where our industry experts drive visible results. </li>
<li>An equal opportunity employment experience that values diversity and inclusion. </li>
<li>Market competitive compensation and benefits with flexible working arrangements.   </li>
</ul>
<p> </p>
<p><span style="font-size:12.0pt"><strong>Apply Now</strong></span></p>
<p><br>If you are inspired to be part of our promise to protect what’s good; for food, people, and the planet, apply through our careers page at <a href="https://jobs.tetrapak.com/">https://jobs.tetrapak.com/</a>.</p>
<p>This job posting expires on <strong>November 5, 2026.</strong></p>
<p> </p>
<p> </p>
