We give people a place to belong and support to thrive, an environment where everyone can be comfortable being themselves and has equal opportunities to grow and succeed. We embrace difference, celebrate people for who they are, and for the diversity they bring that helps us better understand and connect with our customers and communities worldwide.</em><br><em> </em></p>
<p><br><em>We are committed to building an inclusive workplace and welcome applications from all individuals, regardless of background, identity or personal characteristics.</em><em> </em></p>
<p> </p>
<p><em>Our Careers site has a dedicated page to DEI - <a id="menursfk" title="https://www.tetrapak.com/about-tetra-pak/careers/people-and-culture/diversity-equity-and-inclusion" href="https://www.tetrapak.com/about-tetra-pak/careers/people-and-culture/diversity-equity-and-inclusion" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer noopener">Diversity, equity and inclusion | Tetra Pak Global</a></em></p>]]></description><pubDate>Thu, 22 Oct 2026 0:00:00 GMT</pubDate><link>https://jobs.tetrapak.com/job/Monte-Mor-Supply-Chain-Analyst-%28Back-Office-Customer-Service-Representative%29-SP/1450468233/?feedId=null&amp;utm_source=J2WRSS&amp;utm_medium=rss&amp;utm_campaign=J2W_RSS</link><guid>https://jobs.tetrapak.com/job/Monte-Mor-Supply-Chain-Analyst-%28Back-Office-Customer-Service-Representative%29-SP/1450468233/?feedId=null&amp;utm_source=J2WRSS&amp;utm_medium=rss&amp;utm_campaign=J2W_RSS</guid></item><item><title><![CDATA[Analista Supply Chain (Monte Mor, SP, BR)]]></title><description><![CDATA[<p style="text-align:center"> </p>
<p style="text-align:center"><em>Na Tetra Pak, temos o compromisso de tornar os alimentos seguros e disponíveis em todos os lugares; e protegemos o que é bom - protegendo os alimentos, protegendo as pessoas e protegendo o planeta. Ao fazer isso, estamos presentes na vida de milhões de pessoas todos os dias.</em></p>
<p style="text-align:center"><em>E precisamos de pessoas como você para fazer isso acontecer</em></p>
<p style="text-align:center"><strong><em>Apoiamos você a alcançar todo o seu potencial, oferecendo oportunidades para gerar um impacto do qual você possa se orgulhar — nos alimentos, nas pessoas e no planeta.</em></strong></p><div><div style="padding:10.0px 0.0px;border:1.0px solid transparent"><div style="font-size:16.0px;word-wrap:break-word"><H2 style="font-size:1.0em;margin:0.0px"><b>Resumo do trabalho</b></H2></div><div><p> </p>
<p>Estamos procurando um(a) Analista de Supply Chain para proporcionar uma experiência de cliente de classe mundial, promovendo excelência operacional e de qualidade em toda a nossa cadeia de suprimentos. Nesta função, você garantirá o atendimento dos pedidos de forma precisa e dentro dos prazos, ao mesmo tempo em que traduzirá as necessidades dos clientes em ações claras e de impacto. Se você gosta de melhorar processos, simplificar formas de trabalho e identificar oportunidades de automação, esta pode ser a próxima etapa ideal para a sua carreira.</p>
<p><br><strong>Cause impacto do qual você possa se orgulhar – para os alimentos, as pessoas e o planeta.</strong></p>
<p> </p>
<p>A posição está baseada em Monte Mor, São Paulo.</p>
<p> </p></div></div><div style="padding:10.0px 0.0px;border:1.0px solid transparent"><div style="font-size:16.0px;word-wrap:break-word"><H2 style="font-size:1.0em;margin:0.0px"><b>Seu foco será</b></H2></div><div><p> </p>
<p>Como Analista de Supply Chain, você irá:</p>
<p> </p>
<p><strong>Viabilizar o Processo de Gestão de Vendas</strong></p>
<p> </p>
<ul>
<li>Garantir uma cadeia de suprimentos confiável e eficiente para o atendimento de pedidos de Material de Embalagem (PM) e Material Adicional (AM), assegurando a gestão dos dados mestres de design, bem como a eficácia dos processos de pedidos, entregas e faturamento;</li>
<li>Responder às solicitações operacionais relacionadas à documentação, como notas de entrega, faturas proforma, Certificados de Análise e outros materiais necessários;</li>
<li>Priorizar e gerenciar as atividades de back office registradas no Salesforce, fornecendo respostas rápidas aos clientes quando necessário;</li>
</ul>
<p> </p>
<p><strong>Desempenho Operacional e Execução</strong></p>
<p> </p>
<ul>
<li>Contribuir para o aumento da produtividade operacional por meio da resolução proativa de problemas e da melhoria contínua;</li>
<li>Participar ou liderar equipes de Melhoria Contínua para identificar oportunidades de produtividade em processos e ferramentas, em colaboração com o escritório de Melhoria Contínua da fábrica;</li>
<li>Apoiar a análise focada de perdas em KPIs para fortalecer a visibilidade do desempenho e impulsionar ações corretivas;</li>
<li>Desenvolver forte colaboração com parceiros internos, como Front Office Supply Chain, Planejamento e Logística, para garantir o processamento eficiente dos pedidos e níveis de serviço consistentemente elevados;</li>
<li>Escalar para o Front Office Supply Chain quando forem necessários esclarecimentos ou contato direto com o cliente.</li>
</ul>
<p> </p>
<p><strong>Experiência do Cliente</strong></p>
<p> </p>
<ul>
<li>Promover a melhoria contínua das atividades de back office utilizando análise de dados e uma postura proativa para aprimorar a qualidade;</li>
<li>Participar de iniciativas de melhoria voltadas ao cliente lideradas pelo Front Office Supply Chain, contribuindo com seus conhecimentos e experiências;</li>
<li>Atuar como ponto de contato com fábricas e equipes de Integrated Supply Chain para representar a voz do cliente e acelerar a resolução de problemas quando necessário.</li>
</ul></div></div><div style="padding:10.0px 0.0px;border:1.0px solid transparent"><div style="font-size:16.0px;word-wrap:break-word"><H2 style="font-size:1.0em;margin:0.0px"><b>Nós acreditamos que você tem</b></H2></div><div><p> </p>
<ul>
<li>Experiência em supply chain, atendimento ao cliente, gestão de pedidos ou ambiente semelhante por meio de trabalho, estágios, programas de aprendizagem ou posições iniciais de carreira. Candidatos em início de carreira são incentivados a se candidatar;</li>
<li>Fortes habilidades de coordenação e organização, com capacidade de gerenciar múltiplas solicitações, equilibrar prioridades e manter a precisão em um ambiente operacional dinâmico;</li>
<li>Confiança no uso de sistemas digitais, como ERPs, plataformas de gestão de pedidos ou ferramentas de CRM (experiência com Salesforce é um diferencial, mas não obrigatória);</li>
<li>Capacidade de compreender processos ponta a ponta e identificar oportunidades para simplificar, padronizar ou automatizar atividades do dia a dia;</li>
<li>Boas habilidades de comunicação, permitindo colaborar de forma eficaz com diferentes equipes, inclusive remotas;</li>
<li>Capacidade de se comunicar efetivamente em inglês com equipes internacionais;</li>
<li>Mentalidade proativa e voltada para solução de problemas, com curiosidade para desafiar formas atuais de trabalho e contribuir para a melhoria contínua;</li>
<li>Uma abordagem inclusiva, aberta e colaborativa, valorizando diferentes perspectivas e contribuindo para uma cultura de equipe positiva e de apoio mútuo.</li>
</ul></div></div></div><p><span style="font-size:16.0px"><strong> </strong></span></p>
<p><span style="font-size:12.0pt"><strong>Nós Oferecemos</strong></span></p>
<p> </p>
<ul style="list-style-type:disc">
<li>Uma variedade de desafios emocionantes com amplas oportunidades de desenvolvimento e treinamento em um cenário verdadeiramente global</li>
<li>Uma cultura pioneira e  espírito de inovação, onde  nossos especialistas do setor promovem resultados visíveis</li>
<li>Oportunidades iguais de experiência de trabalho que valorizam a diversidade e inclusão</li>
<li>Remuneração e benefícios competitivos de mercado com horários de trabalho flexíveis</li>
</ul>
<p> </p>
<p><span style="font-size:12.0pt"><strong>Candidate se agora!</strong></span></p>
<p><br>Se você se identifica com o nosso propósito de proteger o que é bom para os alimentos, as pessoas e o planeta, candidate-se por meio da nossa página de carreiras em <a href="https://jobs.tetrapak.com/">https://jobs.tetrapak.com/</a>. <br>A data limite para candidaturas para esta posição é:<strong> 5 de Novembro de 2026.</strong></p>
<p> </p>
<p> </p>
<p><em>Diversidade, equidade e inclusão fazem parte do nosso dia a dia. Oferecemos às pessoas um ambiente onde possam pertencer e prosperar, com apoio para se desenvolverem e serem elas mesmas, com igualdade de oportunidades para crescer e ter sucesso. Valorizamos as diferenças, celebramos cada pessoa por quem ela é e pela diversidade que traz, o que nos ajuda a entender melhor e a nos conectar com nossos clientes e comunidades ao redor do mundo.</em><br><em> </em></p>
<p><em>Estamos comprometidos em construir um ambiente de trabalho inclusivo e acolhemos candidaturas de todas as pessoas, independentemente de sua origem, identidade ou características pessoais.</em></p>
<p><br><em>Nosso site de carreiras possui uma página dedicada à Diversidade, Equidade e Inclusão (DEI) -  <a id="menursfk" title="https://www.tetrapak.com/about-tetra-pak/careers/people-and-culture/diversity-equity-and-inclusion" href="https://www.tetrapak.com/about-tetra-pak/careers/people-and-culture/diversity-equity-and-inclusion" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer noopener">Diversity, equity and inclusion | Tetra Pak Global</a></em></p>]]></description><pubDate>Thu, 22 Oct 2026 0:00:00 GMT</pubDate><link>https://jobs.tetrapak.com/job/Monte-Mor-Analista-Supply-Chain-SP/1450468333/?feedId=null&amp;utm_source=J2WRSS&amp;utm_medium=rss&amp;utm_campaign=J2W_RSS</link><guid>https://jobs.tetrapak.com/job/Monte-Mor-Analista-Supply-Chain-SP/1450468333/?feedId=null&amp;utm_source=J2WRSS&amp;utm_medium=rss&amp;utm_campaign=J2W_RSS</guid></item><item><title><![CDATA[Future Talent - CSO Trainee (Manila, PH)]]></title><description><![CDATA[<p><img style="display:block;margin-left:auto;margin-right:auto" src="data:image/png;base64," width="316" height="76"></p>
<p style="text-align:center">At Tetra Pak we commit to making food safe and available, everywhere; and we protect what's good – protecting food, protecting people, and protecting the planet. By doing so we touch millions of people's lives every day.</p>
<p style="text-align:center">And we need people like you to make it happen.</p>
<p style="text-align:center">We empower you to reach your potential with opportunities to  make an impact to be proud of – for food, people and the planet.</p><div><div style="padding:10.0px 0.0px;border:1.0px solid transparent"><div style="font-size:16.0px;word-wrap:break-word"><H2 style="font-size:1.0em;margin:0.0px"><b>Job Summary</b></H2></div><div><p> </p>
<p>Develop competences/skills to become Maintenance Engineer by conducting basic maintenance activities to ensure the smooth running of customer equipment. </p></div></div><div style="padding:10.0px 0.0px;border:1.0px solid transparent"><div style="font-size:16.0px;word-wrap:break-word"><H2 style="font-size:1.0em;margin:0.0px"><b>What you will do</b></H2></div><div><p> </p>
<div>
<p>• Learn and participate in the execution of <strong>preventive maintenance activities</strong>, including on‑the‑job training when required</p>
<p>• Request spare parts and place orders in accordance with <strong>maintenance processes and technical recommendations</strong></p>
<p>• Develop skills to <strong>monitor equipment condition</strong>, identify issues, and restore basic operational functionality</p>
<p>• Support production operators during operations to ensure the <strong>production line runs efficiently and without disruption</strong></p>
<p>• Participate in <strong>equipment installation activities</strong>, including on‑the‑job training when required</p>
<p>• Contribute to maintaining a <strong>clean, organized, and tidy working environment</strong> around machines and production areas</p>
<p>• Execute all tasks in full compliance with <strong>OHS and Tetra Pak safety regulations</strong>, actively promoting a <strong>strong safety culture</strong> within the team</p>

<p style="text-align:center"><span style="font-size:14.0px"><em>At Tetra Pak we commit to making food safe and available, everywhere; and we protect what's good – protecting food, protecting people, and protecting the planet. By doing so we touch millions of people's lives every day. </em></span></p>

<p style="text-align:center"><span style="font-size:14.0px"><em>And we need people like you to make it happen.</em></span></p>

<p style="text-align:center"><b><span style="font-size:14.0px"><em>We empower you to reach your potential with opportunities to  make an impact to be proud of – for food, people and the planet.</em></span></b></p>

<p style="text-align:center"> </p>
<div><div style="padding:10.0px 0.0px;border:1.0px solid transparent"><div style="font-size:16.0px;word-wrap:break-word"><H2 style="font-size:1.0em;margin:0.0px"><b>Job Summary</b></H2></div><div><p> </p>
<p>We are looking for a Quality Technician to be responsible for supporting the operation of the laminator and press by verifying all material (internal and external) is within specification, enter all tests results in the correct database, place non-compliant material on hold, support AM activities as assigned, support laminator and press operational activities and perform actions assigned.  </p>
<p><em>Tetra Pak is not sponsoring work visas or relocation for this position.</em><br> </p></div></div><div style="padding:10.0px 0.0px;border:1.0px solid transparent"><div style="font-size:16.0px;word-wrap:break-word"><H2 style="font-size:1.0em;margin:0.0px"><b>What you will do</b></H2></div><div><p> </p>
<ul>
<li>Verify package quality characteristics are within specification and record test results. Responsible for placing all noncompliant material on hold.</li>
<li>Understand and follow all safety, quality, lamination and press procedures when near machines.</li>
<li>Perform the assigned Autonomous Maintenance (AM) tasks in the lab and on machine, attend all AM meetings.</li>
<li>Assure all material produced is within specification.</li>
<li>Participate in World Class Manufacturing (WCM) team activities to eradicate losses in the process.</li>
<li>Comply with the safety measures and the good manufacturing practices established for the area.</li>
</ul></div></div><div style="padding:10.0px 0.0px;border:1.0px solid transparent"><div style="font-size:16.0px;word-wrap:break-word"><H2 style="font-size:1.0em;margin:0.0px"><b>We believe you have</b></H2></div><div><p> </p>
<ul>
<li>High School Diploma or GED preferred.</li>
<li>
<div>Experience in quality inspection and machine operation.</div>
</li>
<li>
<div>1 to 2 years of experience in a production or manufacturing environment required.</div>
</li>
<li>Basic machine maintenance skills.</li>
<li>Intermediate computer skills.</li>
<li>
<div>Reliable and dependable work ethic.</div>
</li>
<li>Excellent communication skills.</li>
<li>Basic math skills, basic reading comprehension.</li>
<li>Ability to read, understand and comply with work directions, training manuals, safety rules, standard operating procedures and World Class Manufacturing processes.</li>
</ul>
<p> </p>
<p> </p>
<p><span style="font-size:14.0pt"><strong>Shift</strong></span></p>
<ul>
<li>12-hour overnight shifts from 7 PM to 7 AM.</li>
<li>Alternating between 36 hours one week and 48 hours the next week.</li>
<li>Working every other weekend</li>
</ul></div></div></div><p> </p>

<p><b>We Offer You</b></p>

<p> </p>

<ul>
	<li>A variety of exciting challenges with ample opportunities for development and training in a truly global landscape</li>
	<li>A culture that pioneers a spirit of innovation where our industry experts drive visible results</li>
	<li>An equal opportunity employment experience that values diversity and inclusion</li>
	<li>Market competitive compensation and benefit: 401(K) company match, paid time off, paid holidays, health, dental, vision, life and disability insurance, paid parental leave and much more!</li>
</ul>

<p> </p>

<p> </p>

<p><b>Apply Now</b></p>

<p> </p>

<p>If you are inspired to be part of our promise to protect what’s good; for food, people, and the planet, apply through our careers page at <a href="https://jobs.tetrapak.com/" target="_blank">https://jobs.tetrapak.com/</a>. </p>

<p> </p>

We embrace difference, celebrate people for who they are, and for the diversity they bring that helps us better understand and connect with our customers and communities worldwide.</em></p>

<p style="text-align:center"><span style="font-size:12.0pt"><em>At Tetra Pak we commit to making food safe and available, everywhere; and we protect what's good – protecting food, protecting people, and protecting the planet. By doing so we touch millions of people's lives every day. </em></span></p>

Ensures voice of market to Cluster and Global teams.<br>Manages Promotional investment budget.</p>
<p><span>this position require good portion of local &amp; international business travels</span></p></div></div><div style="padding:10.0px 0.0px;border:1.0px solid transparent"><div style="font-size:16.0px;word-wrap:break-word"><H2 style="font-size:1.0em;margin:0.0px"><b>What you will do</b></H2></div><div><p>1. Strong contributor to the development of the Market Business Plan based on analysis of market intelligence covering the entire value chain in identified priority categories.</p>
<p>2. Define, develop and deliver customer marketing initiatives aligned with the cluster growth strategy in close collaboration with KAM teams.  Significant customer interaction.</p>
<p>3. Deliver marketing services for assigned customers drawing materials and methodologies from Cluster /Central organisation.  Has moderate to strong skills in marketing services key modules</p>
<p>4. Provide input to new product requirements based on value chain needs in key categories.</p>
<p>5. Provide input to future intelligence requirements for market and liaise with cluster business intelligence supporting research projects as needed. Analyze and use research data with customers. Provide input to application of market and business intelligence to market company opportunities</p>
<p>6. Manage Promotional Investment investment and programs for assigned customers</p></div></div><div style="padding:10.0px 0.0px;border:1.0px solid transparent"><div style="font-size:16.0px;word-wrap:break-word"><H2 style="font-size:1.0em;margin:0.0px"><b>We believe you have</b></H2></div><div><p>Min 10-15 years of Marketing Experience in a B2B or FMCG company with people management experience and multi-cultural exposure.<br>Preferably as a marketing manager / leader for relevant market for a global organisation.<br>Good level of French and English<br>Degree or MBA or equivalent in Marketing discipline<br>Demonstrated ability to manage significant marketing budgets and deliver measurable ROI.<br>Experience leading cross-functional teams and influencing senior stakeholders.<br>Strong analytical, communication, and project management skills.</p>

<p style="text-align:center"> </p>
<p style="text-align:center">At Tetra Pak we commit to making food safe and available, everywhere; and we protect what's good – protecting food, protecting people, and protecting the planet. By doing so we touch millions of people's lives every day.</p>
<p style="text-align:center">And we need people like you to make it happen.</p>
<p style="text-align:center">We empower you to reach your potential with opportunities to  make an impact to be proud of – for food, people and the planet.</p><div><div style="padding:10.0px 0.0px;border:1.0px solid transparent"><div style="font-size:16.0px;word-wrap:break-word"><H2 style="font-size:1.0em;margin:0.0px"><b>Job Summary</b></H2></div><div><p> </p>
<p>We are seeking a highly motivated Processing Project Engineer to join our team. The successful candidate will be responsible for developing technical solutions in alignment with customer requirements and set standards, calculating project budgets, and preparing the required documentation. You will also contribute to the overall installation business results and customer satisfaction.</p></div></div><div style="padding:10.0px 0.0px;border:1.0px solid transparent"><div style="font-size:16.0px;word-wrap:break-word"><H2 style="font-size:1.0em;margin:0.0px"><b>What you will do</b></H2></div><div><p> </p>
<p>As our Processing Project Engineer, you will:</p>
<p> </p>
<ul type="disc">
<li>Gather engineering data from the project kick-off tollgate to ensure a strong start.</li>
<li>Monitor updates to P&amp;IDs and 3D layouts, ensuring accuracy and compliance.</li>
<li>Investigate and develop opportunities for local sourcing to optimize project resources.</li>
<li>Generate new articles in SAP to streamline project documentation and tracking.</li>
<li>Write detailed technical specifications, requests for quotation, and prepare purchase requisitions.</li>
<li>Organize and lead comprehensive quality reviews to maintain high standards.</li>
<li>Lead risk assessment activities to identify and mitigate potential project risks.</li>
<li>Review budget costs versus actual expenses for relevant equipment and activities to ensure financial efficiency.</li>
<li>Track the delivery of equipment from suppliers to platforms and from platforms to customers, ensuring timely and accurate delivery.</li>
<li>Prepare detailed site installation documents to facilitate smooth and efficient installations.</li>
</ul></div></div><div style="padding:10.0px 0.0px;border:1.0px solid transparent"><div style="font-size:16.0px;word-wrap:break-word"><H2 style="font-size:1.0em;margin:0.0px"><b>We believe you have</b></H2></div><div><p> </p>
<ul type="disc">
<li>Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering or related fields with a focus on process design and project implementation.</li>
<li>Experience in commissioning, maintenance, or new plant start-ups is a plus.</li>
<li>Knowledge in dairy, carbonated beverage, and powder handling process design is a plus.</li>
<li>Familiarity with Tetra Pak or experience in food and beverage factories, especially ice cream factories, would be helpful.</li>
<li>Strong communication, planning, and leadership skills, with the ability to solve problems consistently.</li>
<li>Ability to draw, read, and understand a process and instrumentation diagram (PID).</li>
<li>Intermediate knowledge of AutoCAD and drawing platforms is a must.</li>
</ul></div></div></div><p>We Offer You</p>
<ul type="disc">
<li>A variety of exciting challenges with ample opportunities for development and training in a truly global landscape</li>
<li>A culture that pioneers a spirit of innovation where our industry experts drive visible results</li>
<li>An equal opportunity employment experience that values diversity and inclusion</li>
<li>Market competitive compensation and benefits with flexible working arrangements</li>
</ul>

<p style="text-align:center"><span style="font-size:12.0pt"><em>At Tetra Pak we commit to making food safe and available, everywhere; and we protect what's good – protecting food, protecting people, and protecting the planet. By doing so we touch millions of people's lives every day. </em></span></p>
<p style="text-align:center"><span style="font-size:12.0pt"><em>And we need people like you to make it happen.</em></span></p>
<p style="text-align:center"><span style="font-size:12.0pt"><strong><em>We empower you to reach your potential with opportunities to make an impact to be proud of – for food, people and the planet.</em></strong></span></p><div><div style="padding:10.0px 0.0px;border:1.0px solid transparent"><div style="font-size:16.0px;word-wrap:break-word"><H2 style="font-size:1.0em;margin:0.0px"><b>Job Summary</b></H2></div><div><p style="text-align:justify;margin:0.0cm 0.0cm 8.0pt;line-height:107%;font-size:11.0pt;font-family:Arial, sans-serif"><span style="font-size:12.0pt"><strong>Make an impact to be proud of – for food, people and the planet. </strong></span></p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin:0.0cm 0.0cm 8.0pt;line-height:107%;font-size:11.0pt;font-family:Arial, sans-serif"><span style="font-size:12.0pt">At <strong>Tetra Pak</strong>, no matter what you do, you play a part in achieving our purpose. As part of our <strong>Future Talent Program – Leadership Track</strong>, an 18-month development journey, you'll gain broad business exposure, build leadership capabilities, and take ownership of meaningful work in a truly global environment.</span></p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin:0.0cm 0.0cm 8.0pt;line-height:107%;font-size:11.0pt;font-family:Arial, sans-serif"><span style="font-size:12.0pt">We believe growth is critical to success, which is why we're passionate about providing the experiences, support, and opportunities you need to learn and develop. From day one, you'll be a valued team member with a personalized development plan, hands-on experience, Collaborative projects across teams, and formal training designed to help you advance your skills and enhance your capabilities. You'll be empowered to contribute your ideas, tackle real business challenges, and help deliver solutions that make a difference for our customers and communities.</span></p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin:0.0cm 0.0cm 8.0pt;line-height:107%;font-size:11.0pt;font-family:Arial, sans-serif"><span style="font-size:12.0pt">Along the way, you'll collaborate with colleagues around the world, gain valuable insights into our business, culture, and values, and build a strong professional network. We foster an inclusive environment where diverse perspectives are valued, and innovation is encouraged, giving you the confidence to think differently and grow as a future leader.</span></p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin:0.0cm 0.0cm 8.0pt;line-height:107%;font-size:11.0pt;font-family:Arial, sans-serif"><span style="font-size:12.0pt">We're looking for curious, driven, and collaborative recent graduates who are eager to solve challenges, learn from others, and make a meaningful impact while building a rewarding career with a stable, global company committed to protecting what's good for - food, people and the planet.</span></p>
<p style="margin:0.0cm 0.0cm 8.0pt;line-height:107%;font-size:11.0pt;font-family:Arial, sans-serif"><span style="font-size:12.0pt">The program starts on <strong>February, 2027</strong></span></p>
<p style="line-height:15.0pt;margin:0.0cm 0.0cm 8.0pt;font-size:11.0pt;font-family:Arial, sans-serif"><span style="font-size:12.0pt">The position will be based in <strong>San Fernando, Argentina</strong>.</span></p>
<p style="line-height:15.0pt;margin:0.0cm 0.0cm 8.0pt;font-size:11.0pt;font-family:Arial, sans-serif"><span style="font-size:12.0pt">Tetra Pak does not offer support for visa or relocation for this position.</span></p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin:0.0cm 0.0cm 8.0pt;line-height:107%;font-size:11.0pt;font-family:Arial, sans-serif"><span style="font-size:12.0pt"><em>We strongly encourage applications from individuals belonging to underrepresented or minoritized groups, including women, Black, Indigenous, LGBTQ+ people, people with disabilities, and others.</em></span></p>
<p><span style="font-size:12.0pt"> </span></p></div></div><div style="padding:10.0px 0.0px;border:1.0px solid transparent"><div style="font-size:16.0px;word-wrap:break-word"><H2 style="font-size:1.0em;margin:0.0px"><b>What you will do</b></H2></div><div><p><span style="font-size:12.0pt">As a <strong>Future Talent </strong>being a <strong>Sales Analyst</strong>, you will learn how to:  <br></span><br><span style="font-size:12.0pt">•    Prepare the commercial strategy in support of the sales team, using both internal and external sources;</span><br><span style="font-size:12.0pt">•    Promote, follow-up and analysis of commercial opportunities based on customer information;</span><br><span style="font-size:12.0pt">•    Maintain regular communication by strengthening the relationship with customers and improving the understanding of their strategies and needs, developing solution proposals, to identify opportunities;</span><br><span style="font-size:12.0pt">•    Apply financial analysis to evaluate business opportunities and make strategic decisions;</span><br><span style="font-size:12.0pt">•    Understand our product portfolio and value proposition;</span><br><span style="font-size:12.0pt">•    Organize, prepare and present workshops to the Market clients.</span></p></div></div><div style="padding:10.0px 0.0px;border:1.0px solid transparent"><div style="font-size:16.0px;word-wrap:break-word"><H2 style="font-size:1.0em;margin:0.0px"><b>We believe you have</b></H2></div><div><ul>
<li style="font-size:12.0pt"><span style="font-size:12.0pt">A recent degree in Business, Marketing, Engineering, or a related field;</span></li>
<li style="font-size:12.0pt"><span style="font-size:12.0pt">A strong interest in sales, business development, customer engagement, and commercial negotiations;</span></li>
<li style="font-size:12.0pt"><span style="font-size:12.0pt">Ability to establish fluent conversations in English (Advanced Level);</span></li>
<li style="font-size:12.0pt"><span style="font-size:12.0pt">Collaboration on academic projects or business practices is desirable;</span></li>
<li style="font-size:12.0pt"><span style="font-size:12.0pt">Excellent communication and relationship-building skills, combined with a proactive, customer-centric mindset;</span></li>
<li style="font-size:12.0pt"><span style="font-size:12.0pt">Strong digital and analytical capabilities, including proficiency in PowerPoint, Excel, AI tools, and the ability to make data-driven decisions.</span></li>
</ul></div></div><div style="padding:10.0px 0.0px;border:1.0px solid transparent"><div style="font-size:16.0px;word-wrap:break-word"><H2 style="font-size:1.0em;margin:0.0px"><b>Steps of the Process</b></H2></div><div><ul>
<li style="font-size:12.0pt"><span style="font-size:12.0pt">Application review </span></li>
<li style="font-size:12.0pt"><span style="font-size:12.0pt">Video interview </span></li>
<li style="font-size:12.0pt"><span style="font-size:12.0pt">Interview</span></li>
<li style="font-size:12.0pt"><span style="font-size:12.0pt">Assessment </span></li>
<li style="font-size:12.0pt"><span style="font-size:12.0pt">Offer </span></li>
<li style="font-size:12.0pt"><span style="font-size:12.0pt">Start Date: February , 2027.</span><br><span style="font-size:12.0pt"> </span><br><span style="font-size:12.0pt"> </span></li>
</ul>

<p style="text-align:center"><span style="font-size:12.0pt"><em>At Tetra Pak we commit to making food safe and available, everywhere; and we protect what's good – protecting food, protecting people, and protecting the planet. By doing so we touch millions of people's lives every day. </em></span></p>
<p style="text-align:center"><span style="font-size:12.0pt"><em>And we need people like you to make it happen.</em></span></p>
<p style="text-align:center"><span style="font-size:12.0pt"><strong><em>We empower you to reach your potential with opportunities to make an impact to be proud of – for food, people and the planet.</em></strong></span></p><div><div style="padding:10.0px 0.0px;border:1.0px solid transparent"><div style="font-size:16.0px;word-wrap:break-word"><H2 style="font-size:1.0em;margin:0.0px"><b>Job Summary</b></H2></div><div><p> </p>
<p>At Tetra Pak, we are committed to making food safe and available everywhere. As part of our Sales Administration Support Center, the Senior Order Management &amp; Logistics Support Specialist, plays a key role in driving and coordinating the Support team in terms of daily operations, by ensuring efficient, accurate, and seamless operations. </p>
<p>This role serves as a support to the central coordination point between sales, customers, and internal functions, driving operational excellence and delivering a unique and superior customer experience. </p>
<p>The position is based at our Tetra Pak office in Bogota, Colombia.</p>
<p>Tetra Pak does not offer support for visa or relocation for this position.</p>
<p> </p></div></div><div style="padding:10.0px 0.0px;border:1.0px solid transparent"><div style="font-size:16.0px;word-wrap:break-word"><H2 style="font-size:1.0em;margin:0.0px"><b>What you will do</b></H2></div><div><p> </p>
<p>As an  Senior Order Management &amp; Logistics Support Specialis, you will contribute to delivering world-class service by managing critical spare parts sales operations: </p>
<p> </p>
<ul>
<li>Provide guidance, coaching, and functional support to team members, ensuring effective knowledge transfer, capability development, and increasing team independence in performing daily operations and business processes.</li>
<li>Support the Services Supply Network (SSN) teams in all operational support activities related to the Parts business.</li>
<li>Serve as the main point of contact for internal stakeholders on complex business operations support activities.</li>
<li>Ensure business processes, procedures, and work instructions are properly documented, maintained, and communicated, enabling Sales Support Administrators to perform their activities consistently and efficiently.</li>
<li>Execute/Perform business operation support activities in ERP systems (SAP preferred)</li>
<li>Ensure timely processing, closure, and maintenance of business transactions.</li>
<li>Provide operational support to the Americas Service administration center.</li>
<li>Track order fulfilment status and coordinate actions to resolve backorders and delivery constraints. <br>Support operational efficiency through regular housekeeping and cleansing of ERP systems, master data, and transactional records.</li>
<li>Collaborate closely with regional SSN teams to support operational processes and drive timely resolution of issues</li>
<li>Coordinate and support reverse logistic operational activities with stakeholders to ensure timely outcomes.</li>
<li>Maintain strong communication with stakeholders across time zones.</li>
<li>Ensure compliance with global processes and drive continuous improvements</li>
<li>Responsible for Purchase to Payment (PTP) Process</li>
<li>Responsible for ensuring timely delivery of parts from Tetra Pak suppliers, including taking corrective actions to address delays and supply shortages.</li>
<li>Inform and act on all deviations to secure an effective and timely PTP Process. </li>
</ul>
<p> </p></div></div><div style="padding:10.0px 0.0px;border:1.0px solid transparent"><div style="font-size:16.0px;word-wrap:break-word"><H2 style="font-size:1.0em;margin:0.0px"><b>We believe you have</b></H2></div><div><p> </p>
<ul>
<li>A university degree in Business Administration, Logistics, Supply Chain, or related fields.</li>
<li>Strong experience in Sales Administration / Order Management/ Supply Chain (preferably in a shared services environment)</li>
<li>Proficiency in English, with the ability to read, write, and communicate effectively in a business environment.</li>
<li>Strong experience with ERP systems (SAP preferred)</li>
<li>Advanced knowledge of Microsoft Excel (Formulas, Pivot, Macros, etc) and reporting tools Power BI and others).</li>
<li>Demonstrated ability to influence, engage, and work effectively with stakeholders and team members across a wide range of personalities and behavioral styles.</li>
<li>Strong attention to detail, problem-solving mindset, and communication skills.</li>
<li>Ability to manage high-volume of operational tasks in a fast-paced, global environment</li>
<li>Strong problem-solving and continuous improvement mindset, customer-oriented skills, high motivation, teamwork spirit, analytical thinking, and fast learning ability.</li>
</ul>
<p> </p></div></div></div><p> </p>
<p><strong>We Offer You</strong></p>
<p> </p>
<ul>
<li>A variety of exciting challenges with ample opportunities for
